/* FILE: app/Services/SecureFileUpload.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Services\SecurityLogger;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

/**
 * OWASP A1: Injection - Secure File Upload Service
 * Provides secure file upload handling with comprehensive validation
 */
class SecureFileUpload
{
    /**
     * Allowed MIME types for different file categories
     */
    protected array $allowedMimeTypes = [
        'images' => [
            'image/jpeg',
            'image/png',
            'image/gif',
            'image/webp',
        ],
        'documents' => [
            'application/pdf',
            'application/msword',
            'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
            'text/plain',
        ],
        'reports' => [
            'image/jpeg',
            'image/png',
            'image/gif',
        ],
        'concerns' => [
            'image/jpeg',
            'image/png',
            'image/gif',
        ],
    ];

    /**
     * Maximum file sizes in bytes
     */
    protected array $maxFileSizes = [
        'images' => 2048 * 1024, // 2MB
        'documents' => 5120 * 1024, // 5MB
        'reports' => 2048 * 1024, // 2MB
        'concerns' => 2048 * 1024, // 2MB
    ];

    /**
     * Dangerous file extensions to block
     */
    protected array $dangerousExtensions = [
        'exe', 'bat', 'cmd', 'com', 'pif', 'scr', 'vbs', 'js', 'jar',
        'php', 'php3', 'php4', 'php5', 'phtml', 'asp', 'aspx', 'jsp',
        'cgi', 'pl', 'py', 'sh', 'dll', 'so', 'dylib',
    ];

    /**
     * Validate and store uploaded file securely
     *
     * @param UploadedFile $file
     * @param string $category (images, documents, reports, concerns)
     * @param string $directory
     * @return string|null Path to stored file or null if validation failed
     */
    public function validateAndStore(UploadedFile $file, string $category, string $directory): ?string
    {
        try {
            if (in_array($category, ['images', 'reports', 'concerns'], true)) {
                ImageUploadSecurity::validate($file);
            }
            // 1. Check if file is valid
            if (!$file->isValid()) {
                SecurityLogger::logFileUploadSecurity([
                    'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                    'reason' => 'Invalid file upload',
                ]);
                return null;
            }

            // 2. Validate file size
            if (!$this->validateFileSize($file, $category)) {
                SecurityLogger::logFileUploadSecurity([
                    'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                    'filesize' => $file->getSize(),
                    'reason' => 'File size exceeds limit',
                ]);
                return null;
            }

            // 3. Validate MIME type
            if (!$this->validateMimeType($file, $category)) {
                SecurityLogger::logFileUploadSecurity([
                    'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                    'mimetype' => $file->getMimeType(),
                    'reason' => 'Invalid MIME type',
                ]);
                return null;
            }

            // 4. Check for dangerous file extensions
            if ($this->hasDangerousExtension($file)) {
                SecurityLogger::logFileUploadSecurity([
                    'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                    'reason' => 'Dangerous file extension detected',
                ]);
                return null;
            }

            // 5. Generate secure filename
            $secureFilename = $this->generateSecureFilename($file);

            // 6. Store file
            $path = $file->storeAs($directory, $secureFilename, 'public');

            // 7. Verify file was stored correctly
            if (!Storage::disk('public')->exists($path)) {
                SecurityLogger::logFileUploadSecurity([
                    'filename' => $secureFilename,
                    'reason' => 'File storage failed',
                ]);
                return null;
            }

            return $path;

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            SecurityLogger::logFileUploadSecurity([
                'filename' => $file->getClientOriginalName(),
                'reason' => 'Exception during file upload: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ]);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validate file size
     */
    protected function validateFileSize(UploadedFile $file, string $category): bool
    {
        $maxSize = $this->maxFileSizes[$category] ?? $this->maxFileSizes['images'];
        return $file->getSize() <= $maxSize;
    }

    /**
     * Validate MIME type
     */
    protected function validateMimeType(UploadedFile $file, string $category): bool
    {
        $allowedTypes = $this->allowedMimeTypes[$category] ?? $this->allowedMimeTypes['images'];
        return in_array($file->getMimeType(), $allowedTypes);
    }

    /**
     * Check for dangerous file extensions
     */
    protected function hasDangerousExtension(UploadedFile $file): bool
    {
        $extension = strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension());
        return in_array($extension, $this->dangerousExtensions);
    }

    /**
     * Generate secure filename — fully random, no guessable basename
     */
    protected function generateSecureFilename(UploadedFile $file): string
    {
        $extension = $file->guessExtension();
        return bin2hex(random_bytes(16)) . '.' . $extension;
    }

    /**
     * Delete file securely
     */
    public function deleteFile(string $path): bool
    {
        try {
            if (Storage::disk('public')->exists($path)) {
                return Storage::disk('public')->delete($path);
            }
            return true; // File doesn't exist, consider it "deleted"
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            SecurityLogger::logFileUploadSecurity([
                'filename' => $path,
                'reason' => 'Exception during file deletion: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ]);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get file validation rules for form request validation
     */
    public function getValidationRules(string $category): array
    {
        $maxSize = $this->maxFileSizes[$category] ?? $this->maxFileSizes['images'];
        $maxSizeKB = intval($maxSize / 1024);

        $allowedTypes = $this->allowedMimeTypes[$category] ?? $this->allowedMimeTypes['images'];

        return [
            'required',
            'file',
            'max:' . $maxSizeKB,
            function ($attribute, $value, $fail) use ($allowedTypes) {
                if ($value && !in_array($value->getMimeType(), $allowedTypes)) {
                    $fail('The ' . $attribute . ' must be a valid file type.');
                }
            },
        ];
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Services/SecurityLogger.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

/**
 * OWASP A9: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
 * Centralized security logging service
 */
class SecurityLogger
{
    /**
     * Resolve the preferred security log channel with fallback.
     */
    protected static function channel()
    {
        try {
            return Log::channel('security');
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return Log::channel(config('logging.default'));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Log suspicious login activity
     */
    public static function logSuspiciousLogin(array $data): void
    {
        static::channel()->warning('Suspicious login attempt', [
            'ip' => $data['ip'] ?? request()->ip(),
            'email' => $data['email'] ?? null,
            'user_agent' => $data['user_agent'] ?? request()->userAgent(),
            'reason' => $data['reason'] ?? 'Unknown',
            'timestamp' => now()->toISOString(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Log unauthorized access attempt
     */
    public static function logUnauthorizedAccess(array $data): void
    {
        static::channel()->warning('Unauthorized access attempt', [
            'user_id' => $data['user_id'] ?? auth()->id(),
            'ip' => $data['ip'] ?? request()->ip(),
            'url' => $data['url'] ?? request()->fullUrl(),
            'method' => $data['method'] ?? request()->method(),
            'user_agent' => $data['user_agent'] ?? request()->userAgent(),
            'reason' => $data['reason'] ?? 'Access denied',
            'timestamp' => now()->toISOString(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Log potential security breach
     */
    public static function logSecurityBreach(array $data): void
    {
        static::channel()->error('Potential security breach', [
            'type' => $data['type'] ?? 'Unknown',
            'user_id' => $data['user_id'] ?? auth()->id(),
            'ip' => $data['ip'] ?? request()->ip(),
            'details' => $data['details'] ?? [],
            'severity' => $data['severity'] ?? 'medium',
            'timestamp' => now()->toISOString(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Log rate limit exceeded
     */
    public static function logRateLimitExceeded(array $data): void
    {
        static::channel()->warning('Rate limit exceeded', [
            'ip' => $data['ip'] ?? request()->ip(),
            'url' => $data['url'] ?? request()->fullUrl(),
            'user_agent' => $data['user_agent'] ?? request()->userAgent(),
            'attempts' => $data['attempts'] ?? 0,
            'limit' => $data['limit'] ?? 0,
            'timestamp' => now()->toISOString(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Log file upload security event
     */
    public static function logFileUploadSecurity(array $data): void
    {
        static::channel()->warning('File upload security event', [
            'user_id' => $data['user_id'] ?? auth()->id(),
            'filename' => $data['filename'] ?? 'Unknown',
            'filesize' => $data['filesize'] ?? 0,
            'mimetype' => $data['mimetype'] ?? 'Unknown',
            'ip' => $data['ip'] ?? request()->ip(),
            'reason' => $data['reason'] ?? 'Security check failed',
            'timestamp' => now()->toISOString(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Log admin action for audit trail
     */
    public static function logAdminAction(array $data): void
    {
        static::channel()->info('Admin action performed', [
            'user_id' => $data['user_id'] ?? auth()->id(),
            'action' => $data['action'] ?? 'Unknown',
            'resource_type' => $data['resource_type'] ?? 'Unknown',
            'resource_id' => $data['resource_id'] ?? null,
            'ip' => $data['ip'] ?? request()->ip(),
            'details' => $data['details'] ?? [],
            'timestamp' => now()->toISOString(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Log input validation failure
     */
    public static function logValidationFailure(array $data): void
    {
        static::channel()->warning('Input validation failure', [
            'user_id' => $data['user_id'] ?? auth()->id(),
            'ip' => $data['ip'] ?? request()->ip(),
            'url' => $data['url'] ?? request()->fullUrl(),
            'validation_errors' => $data['errors'] ?? [],
            'input_data' => $data['input'] ?? [],
            'timestamp' => now()->toISOString(),
        ]);
    }
}

/* FILE: app/Services/SmsService.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\Client\ConnectionException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class SmsService
{
    private ?string $failureCode = null;

    private bool $deliveryUncertain = false;

    public function deliveryMayHaveSucceeded(): bool
    {
        return $this->deliveryUncertain;
    }

    public function failureMessage(): string
    {
        $code = $this->failureCode ?? 'SMS-UNKNOWN';
        $message = match ($code) {
            'SMS-PHONE' => 'Your saved phone number is not a valid Philippine mobile number.',
            'SMS-RATE-LIMIT' => 'SMS requests are temporarily limited. Please wait before trying again.',
            'SMS-NETWORK' => 'The SMS sender cannot deliver to your mobile network.',
            default => 'SMS verification is temporarily unavailable.',
        };

        return $message.' Please choose email instead. Reference: '.$code.'.';
    }

    public function sendOtp(string $phoneNumber, string $otp): bool
    {
        return $this->sendMessage($phoneNumber, "Your CampFix verification code is: {$otp}. This code expires in 5 minutes.");
    }

    public function sendSmsNotification(string $phoneNumber, string $message): bool
    {
        return $this->sendMessage($phoneNumber, $message);
    }

    private function sendMessage(string $phoneNumber, string $message): bool
    {
        $this->failureCode = null;
        $this->deliveryUncertain = false;
        $apiKey = trim((string) config('services.sms.api_key'));
        $apiUrl = trim((string) config('services.sms.api_url'));
        $senderId = trim((string) (config('services.sms.sender_id') ?: config('services.sms.sender_name', 'CampFix')));
        $recipient = $this->cleanPhoneNumber($phoneNumber);

        if ($apiKey === '' || $apiUrl === '' || $senderId === '') {
            $this->recordFailure($apiKey === '' ? 'SMS-CONFIG-KEY' : ($apiUrl === '' ? 'SMS-CONFIG-URL' : 'SMS-CONFIG-SENDER'));
            Log::warning('UniSMS is not configured', [
                'missing_api_key' => $apiKey === '',
                'missing_api_url' => $apiUrl === '',
                'missing_sender_id' => $senderId === '',
            ]);

            return false;
        }

        if ($recipient === null) {
            $this->recordFailure('SMS-PHONE');
            Log::warning('UniSMS recipient is not a valid Philippine mobile number');

            return false;
        }

        try {
            // UniSMS requires an account-approved sender ID on every request.
            $response = Http::connectTimeout(5)->timeout(20)
                ->withBasicAuth($apiKey, '')
                ->acceptJson()->asJson()
                ->post($apiUrl, [
                    'recipient' => $recipient,
                    'content' => $message,
                    'sender_id' => $senderId,
                ]);

            $status = $response->json('message.status');
            if (! $response->successful() || $status === 'failed' || $response->json('success') === false) {
                $this->recordFailure($this->providerFailureCode($response->status(), $response->json() ?? []));
                // Provider responses can echo the OTP, recipient and message. Log only safe diagnostics.
                Log::warning('UniSMS rejected the message', [
                    'http_status' => $response->status(),
                    'message_failed' => $status === 'failed',
                    'validation_fields' => array_keys((array) $response->json('errors', [])),
                ]);

                return false;
            }

            Log::info('UniSMS accepted the message', ['http_status' => $response->status()]);

            return true;
        } catch (\Exception $exception) {
            $errno = $this->curlErrorNumber($exception);
            $transportFailure = $exception instanceof ConnectionException;
            $code = $transportFailure ? match ($errno) {
                3 => 'SMS-CONFIG-URL',
                5, 6 => 'SMS-DNS',
                7 => 'SMS-CONNECT',
                28 => 'SMS-TIMEOUT',
                35, 51, 58, 60, 77, 83, 90, 91 => 'SMS-TLS',
                default => 'SMS-CONNECTION',
            } : 'SMS-CLIENT';
            // A timeout or lost response can happen after UniSMS accepts and sends the SMS.
            // Never retry the billable POST automatically or discard its verification challenge.
            $this->deliveryUncertain = $transportFailure && ! in_array($code, ['SMS-CONFIG-URL', 'SMS-DNS', 'SMS-CONNECT', 'SMS-TLS'], true);
            $this->recordFailure($code);
            // Connection exceptions can embed request details, so do not log their message.
            Log::warning('UniSMS connection failed', ['exception_type' => get_class($exception), 'curl_errno' => $errno, 'delivery_uncertain' => $this->deliveryUncertain]);

            return false;
        }
    }

    private function curlErrorNumber(\Exception $exception): ?int
    {
        $cause = $exception;
        for ($depth = 0; $cause && $depth < 5; $depth++, $cause = $cause->getPrevious()) {
            if (method_exists($cause, 'getHandlerContext')) {
                $context = $cause->getHandlerContext();
                if (! empty($context['errno'])) {
                    return (int) $context['errno'];
                }
            }
            if (preg_match('/cURL error\s+(\d+)/i', $cause->getMessage(), $match)) {
                return (int) $match[1];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function recordFailure(string $code): void
    {
        $this->failureCode = $code;
        Log::warning('UniSMS delivery failure', ['code' => $code]);
    }

    private function providerFailureCode(int $httpStatus, mixed $payload): string
    {
        $payload = is_array($payload) ? $payload : [];
        if (in_array($httpStatus, [401, 403], true)) {
            return 'SMS-AUTH';
        }
        if ($httpStatus === 429) {
            return 'SMS-RATE-LIMIT';
        }

        // Classify errors into fixed codes without exposing any provider response content.
        $errors = $payload['errors'] ?? [];
        $reason = strtolower(json_encode([$errors, $payload['message']['fail_reason'] ?? null]) ?: '');
        if ($httpStatus === 402 || str_contains($reason, 'credit') || str_contains($reason, 'balance')) {
            return 'SMS-CREDITS';
        }
        // UniSMS's default sender rejects some networks with a recipient validation error.
        // Its wording includes "Sender ID", so identify this before generic sender errors.
        if (preg_match('/smart|\btnt\b|\bsun\b|network/', $reason)
            && preg_match('/can.t send|cannot send|not supported|unsupported|not allowed|restricted/', $reason)) {
            return 'SMS-NETWORK';
        }
        if ((is_array($errors) && array_key_exists('sender_id', $errors)) || str_contains($reason, 'sender')) {
            return 'SMS-SENDER';
        }
        if (is_array($errors) && array_key_exists('recipient', $errors)) {
            return 'SMS-PHONE';
        }

        return 'SMS-PROVIDER-'.$httpStatus;
    }

    private function cleanPhoneNumber(string $phoneNumber): ?string
    {
        $digits = preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $phoneNumber);
        if (str_starts_with($digits, '0063')) {
            $digits = substr($digits, 2);
        } elseif (preg_match('/^09\d{9}$/', $digits)) {
            $digits = '63'.substr($digits, 1);
        } elseif (preg_match('/^9\d{9}$/', $digits)) {
            $digits = '63'.$digits;
        }

        return preg_match('/^639\d{9}$/', $digits) ? '+'.$digits : null;
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Services/StaffImportReview.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class StaffImportReview
{
    public const DEPARTMENTS = ['GE', 'ICT', 'Business Management', 'THM'];

    public const ROLES = [
        'faculty' => 'Faculty / Other Staff', 'maintenance' => 'Maintenance', 'mis' => 'MIS',
        'school_admin' => 'School Administrator', 'building_admin' => 'Building Administrator',
        'academic_head' => 'Academic Head', 'program_head' => 'Program Head', 'principal_assistant' => 'Principal Assistant',
    ];

    public function parse(UploadedFile $file, string $format): array
    {
        $tabSeparated = $format === 'masterlist';
        if (strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension()) !== 'xlsx') {
            $header = strtok(file_get_contents($file->getRealPath()), "\r\n") ?: '';
            $tabSeparated = substr_count($header, "\t") > substr_count($header, ',');
        }
        $rows = app(UserImportFile::class)->rows($file, $tabSeparated, false);
        $headers = array_map(fn ($value) => strtolower(trim((string) $value, " \t\n\r\0\x0B\xEF\xBB\xBF")), $rows[0] ?? []);
        $nameIndex = array_search('name', $headers, true);
        $emailIndex = array_search('email', $headers, true);
        $roleIndex = array_search('role', $headers, true);
        $result = [];
        foreach (array_slice($rows, 1, null, true) as $index => $row) {
            $row = array_map(fn ($value) => trim((string) $value), $row);
            if (! array_filter($row, fn ($value) => $value !== '')) continue;
            if ($nameIndex !== false && $emailIndex !== false) {
                $name = $row[$nameIndex] ?? ''; $email = $row[$emailIndex] ?? '';
                $role = $roleIndex !== false ? ($row[$roleIndex] ?? '') : '';
                $employee = null; $password = Str::password(16);
            } elseif ($format === 'masterlist' && count($row) >= 6) {
                $name = trim(($row[2] ?? '').' '.($row[3] ?? '').' '.($row[1] ?? ''));
                if (blank($row[1] ?? null) || blank($row[2] ?? null)) continue;
                $first = strtolower(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z]/', '', $row[2]));
                $last = strtolower(preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z]/', '', $row[1]));
                $email = $first.'.'.$last.'@novaliches.sti.edu.ph';
                $employee = preg_replace('/\s+/', '', $row[5]) ?: null;
                $password = ucfirst($last).'_'.ucfirst($first).'_'.now()->year;
                $role = $row[6] ?? '';
            } elseif ($format === 'standard' && count($row) >= 3) {
                $employee = $row[0] ?: null; $name = $row[0]; $email = $row[1];
                $password = $row[2] ?: Str::password(16); $role = $row[3] ?? '';
            } else {
                continue;
            }
            $role = strtolower(str_replace([' ', '-'], '_', trim($role)));
            $role = ['school_administrator' => 'school_admin', 'building_administrator' => 'building_admin',
                'laboratory_custodian' => 'maintenance'][$role] ?? $role;
            if (($employee !== null && mb_strlen($employee) > 255) || mb_strlen($password) > 1000) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['file' => 'Row '.($index + 1).' contains an employee ID or password that exceeds the allowed length.']);
            }
            $result[] = ['row_id' => (string) $index, 'name' => $name, 'email' => strtolower($email),
                'role' => array_key_exists($role, self::ROLES) ? $role : 'faculty',
                'employee_id' => $employee, 'password' => $password];
        }
        if (! $result) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['file' => 'No staff users were found. Upload a staff masterlist or a CSV with Name, Email, Role columns.']);
        return $result;
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Services/StudentMasterlistRows.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

class StudentMasterlistRows
{
    /** Map combined-name school masterlists to the legacy import layout. */
    public static function normalize(array $rows): array
    {
        $columns = null;
        $result = [['Student ID', 'Omega ID', 'Last Name', 'First Name', 'Middle Name', 'Program', 'Level']];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $headers = array_map(fn ($value) => strtolower(trim((string) $value)), $row);
            if (in_array('student id', $headers, true) && in_array('student name', $headers, true)) {
                $columns = array_flip($headers);
                continue;
            }
            if ($columns === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $id = trim((string) ($row[$columns['student id']] ?? ''));
            if (! preg_match('/^\d{11}$/', $id)) {
                continue;
            }
            $name = trim((string) ($row[$columns['student name']] ?? ''));
            $parts = explode(',', $name, 2);
            $result[] = [$id, '', trim($parts[0]), trim($parts[1] ?? ''), '',
                trim((string) ($row[$columns['program'] ?? -1] ?? '')),
                trim((string) ($row[$columns['level'] ?? -1] ?? ''))];
        }

        return $columns === null ? $rows : $result;
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Services/SupabaseStorage.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class SupabaseStorage
{
    protected $url;
    protected $key;
    protected $bucket;

    public function __construct()
    {
        // Try integration variables first, fallback to custom variables
        $this->url = config('services.supabase.url') 
            ?? env('NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL') 
            ?? env('SUPABASE_URL');
        
        // Use service_role key from integration or custom variable
        $this->key = config('services.supabase.key') 
            ?? env('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY') 
            ?? env('SUPABASE_KEY');
        
        $this->bucket = config('services.supabase.bucket', 'concerns');
        
        // Clean up URL - remove https:// if present
        if ($this->url) {
            $this->url = str_replace(['https://', 'http://'], '', $this->url);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Upload file to Supabase Storage
     *
     * @param UploadedFile $file
     * @param string $path
     * @return string|null Public URL of uploaded file or null on failure
     */
    public function upload(UploadedFile $file, string $path): ?string
    {
        ImageUploadSecurity::validate($file);
        try {
            $filename = $path . '/' . ImageUploadSecurity::filename($file);
            
            Log::info('Attempting Supabase upload', [
                'filename' => $filename,
                'url' => $this->url,
                'bucket' => $this->bucket,
                'has_key' => !empty($this->key)
            ]);
            
            $response = Http::withHeaders([
                'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $this->key,
                'Content-Type' => $file->getMimeType(),
            ])->withBody(
                file_get_contents($file->getRealPath()),
                $file->getMimeType()
            )->post("https://{$this->url}/storage/v1/object/{$this->bucket}/{$filename}");

            Log::info('Supabase upload response', [
                'status' => $response->status(),
                'body' => $response->body()
            ]);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                // Return public HTTPS URL
                $publicUrl = "https://{$this->url}/storage/v1/object/public/{$this->bucket}/{$filename}";
                Log::info('Supabase upload successful', ['url' => $publicUrl]);
                return $publicUrl;
            }

            Log::error('Supabase upload failed', [
                'status' => $response->status(),
                'body' => $response->body()
            ]);

            return null;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Supabase upload exception: ' . $e->getMessage(), [
                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString()
            ]);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Delete file from Supabase Storage
     *
     * @param string $url
     * @return bool
     */
    public function delete(string $url): bool
    {
        try {
            // Extract filename from URL
            $filename = str_replace("https://{$this->url}/storage/v1/object/public/{$this->bucket}/", '', $url);
            
            $response = Http::withHeaders([
                'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $this->key,
            ])->delete("https://{$this->url}/storage/v1/object/{$this->bucket}/{$filename}");

            return $response->successful();
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Supabase delete exception: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Services/TicketHistoryService.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Concern;
use App\Models\MaintenanceStaff;
use App\Models\Report;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class TicketHistoryService
{
    // Call after the detail endpoint has authorized access to the ticket itself.
    public function renderFor(Concern|Report $ticket, User $viewer): string
    {
        $replacementService = app(AssetReplacementService::class);
        $canRecordReplacement = $replacementService->canRecord($ticket, $viewer);
        if (! $viewer->isSystemAdministrator()
            && ! in_array($viewer->role, ['mis', 'building_admin', 'school_admin'], true)
            && ! ($viewer->role === 'maintenance' && (int) $ticket->assigned_to === (int) $viewer->id)
            && !$canRecordReplacement) {
            return '';
        }

        $source = $ticket;
        $type = $source instanceof Concern ? 'concern' : 'report';
        $current = $this->snapshot($source);
        $logs = ActivityLog::with('user')
            ->where($type.'_id', $source->id)
            ->where('action', $type.'_reopened')
            ->orderByDesc('id')->get();
        // Reports created after an earlier reopening may only have concern history.
        if ($logs->isEmpty() && $ticket instanceof Report && $ticket->concern_id) {
            $logs = ActivityLog::with('user')->where('concern_id', $ticket->concern_id)
                ->where('action', 'concern_reopened')->orderByDesc('id')->get();
        }
        $history = $logs->map(function (ActivityLog $log) use ($current) {
            $saved = $log->old_values ?? [];
            if (! array_key_exists('assignee_name', $saved)) {
                $technology = strtolower(trim($saved['category_name'] ?? $current['category_name'] ?? '')) === 'technology/internet';
                $saved['assignee_name'] = $this->assigneeName($saved['assigned_to'] ?? null, $technology);
            }

            return array_merge($this->details(array_replace($current, $saved)), [
                'label' => 'Previous repair',
                'legacy' => ! isset($saved['snapshot_version']),
                'reopened_at' => $this->date($log->created_at),
                'reopened_by' => ! empty($saved['is_anonymous']) && (int) $log->user_id === (int) ($saved['user_id'] ?? 0)
                    ? 'Anonymous' : ($log->user?->name ?? 'Unavailable user'),
                'reason' => $log->metadata['reason'] ?? $log->description,
            ]);
        });

        if ($source->status === 'Resolved' && $source->resolved_at) {
            $history->prepend(array_merge($this->details($current), [
                'label' => 'Latest resolution', 'reopened_at' => null, 'legacy' => false,
            ]));
        }

        return view('partials.ticket-history', ['history' => $history])->render()
            .view('partials.asset-replacement', ['ticket' => $ticket, 'canRecordReplacement' => $canRecordReplacement,
                'replacements' => $replacementService->historyFor($ticket)])->render();
    }

    public function snapshot(Concern|Report $ticket): array
    {
        $other = $ticket instanceof Report
            ? $ticket->concern
            : Report::where('concern_id', $ticket->id)->latest('id')->first();
        $fields = ['id', 'title', 'description', 'details', 'location', 'location_type', 'room_number',
            'category_id', 'user_id', 'reporter_name', 'reported_by_name', 'reporter_email', 'reporter_role',
            'reporter_department', 'reporter_phone', 'reporter_student_id', 'is_anonymous', 'status',
            'priority', 'severity', 'is_safety_hazard', 'report_count', 'image_path', 'photo_path',
            'created_at', 'assigned_to', 'assigned_at', 'in_progress_at', 'resolved_at', 'resolution_notes',
            'cost', 'damaged_part', 'replaced_part', 'budget_amount', 'budget_status', 'budget_requested_by',
            'budget_requested_at', 'budget_reviewed_by', 'budget_reviewed_at', 'budget_rejection_reason'];
        $values = $ticket->only($fields);
        foreach ($fields as $field) {
            if ($field !== 'id' && $values[$field] === null && $other?->getAttribute($field) !== null) {
                $values[$field] = $other->getAttribute($field);
            }
        }
        $values['snapshot_version'] = 1;
        $values['reference'] = ($ticket instanceof Concern ? 'Concern #' : 'Report #').str_pad((string) $ticket->id, 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $values['category_name'] = Category::find($values['category_id'])?->name;
        $technology = strtolower(trim($values['category_name'] ?? '')) === 'technology/internet';
        $values['assignee_name'] = $this->assigneeName($values['assigned_to'], $technology);
        $reporter = $ticket->user;
        $values['reporter_name'] ??= $values['reported_by_name'] ?? $reporter?->name;
        foreach (['email', 'role', 'department', 'phone', 'student_id'] as $field) {
            $values['reporter_'.$field] ??= $reporter?->getAttribute($field);
        }
        $values['budget_requested_by_name'] = $values['budget_requested_by'] ? User::withoutGlobalScopes()->find($values['budget_requested_by'])?->name : null;
        $values['budget_reviewed_by_name'] = $values['budget_reviewed_by'] ? User::withoutGlobalScopes()->find($values['budget_reviewed_by'])?->name : null;

        return $values;
    }

    private function assigneeName($id, bool $technology): ?string
    {
        if (! $id) {
            return null;
        }
        // Legacy assignments can reference either accounts or maintenance staff.
        $user = User::withoutGlobalScopes()->find($id);
        $staff = MaintenanceStaff::withTrashed()->find($id);

        return $technology ? ($user?->name ?? $staff?->name) : ($staff?->name ?? $user?->name);
    }

    private function details(array $values): array
    {
        $anonymous = (bool) ($values['is_anonymous'] ?? false);
        $photo = $values['photo_path'] ?? $values['image_path'] ?? null;
        $photoUrl = null;
        if ($photo) {
            if (preg_match('~^https?://~i', $photo)) {
                $photoUrl = $photo;
            } elseif (! preg_match('~^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:|^//~i', $photo)) {
                $photoUrl = asset('storage/'.ltrim($photo, '/'));
            }
        }

        return array_merge($values, [
            'reported_by' => $anonymous ? 'Anonymous' : ($values['reporter_name'] ?? 'Unavailable user'),
            'reporter_contact' => $anonymous ? [] : array_filter([
                'Email' => $values['reporter_email'], 'Role' => $values['reporter_role'],
                'Department' => $values['reporter_department'], 'Phone' => $values['reporter_phone'],
                'Student ID' => $values['reporter_student_id'],
            ], fn ($value) => $value !== null && $value !== ''),
            'assigned_to' => $values['assignee_name'] ?? ($values['assigned_to'] ? 'Unavailable assignee (#'.$values['assigned_to'].')' : 'Unassigned'),
            'priority' => ucfirst($values['priority'] ?? $values['severity'] ?? 'Not set'),
            'report_count' => $values['report_count'] ?? 1,
            'photo_url' => $photoUrl,
            'created_at' => $this->date($values['created_at']),
            'assigned_at' => $this->date($values['assigned_at'] ?? null),
            'in_progress_at' => $this->date($values['in_progress_at'] ?? null),
            'resolved_at' => $this->date($values['resolved_at'] ?? null),
            'resolution_notes' => $values['resolution_notes'] ?? null,
            'cost' => $values['cost'] ?? null,
            'damaged_part' => $values['damaged_part'] ?? null,
            'replaced_part' => $values['replaced_part'] ?? null,
            'budget_requested_at' => $this->date($values['budget_requested_at']),
            'budget_reviewed_at' => $this->date($values['budget_reviewed_at']),
        ]);
    }

    private function date($value): ?string
    {
        return $value ? Carbon::parse($value)->timezone('Asia/Manila')->format('M d, Y h:i A') : null;
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Services/TicketRecurrenceService.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Concern;
use App\Models\Report;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class TicketRecurrenceService
{
    /** Completed repairs preserved when a ticket was reopened, keyed by ticket ID. */
    public function histories(Collection $tickets): Collection
    {
        return $this->forCurrentAssets($tickets)['histories'];
    }

    public function forCurrentAssets(Collection $tickets): array
    {
        $histories = $this->allHistories($tickets);
        $service = app(AssetReplacementService::class);
        $replacements = $service->latestFor($tickets);
        $current = $tickets->filter(function ($ticket) use ($service, $replacements, $histories) {
            $replacement = $replacements->get($service->scopeKey($ticket));
            if (!$replacement) return true;
            $baseline = $replacement->metadata[$ticket instanceof Report ? 'baseline_report_ids' : 'baseline_concern_ids'] ?? [];
            $events = $histories->get($ticket->id, collect())->filter(fn ($event) => $event['log_id'] > $replacement->id)->values();
            if (in_array((int) $ticket->id, array_map('intval', $baseline), true)) {
                if ($events->isEmpty()) {
                    $histories->put($ticket->id, collect());
                    return false;
                }
                // The first later reopening is the new asset's first failure;
                // its saved resolution still belongs to the previous asset.
                $events->shift();
            }
            $histories->put($ticket->id, $events);
            return true;
        });
        return ['tickets' => $current, 'histories' => $histories];
    }

    private function allHistories(Collection $tickets): Collection
    {
        $result = $tickets->mapWithKeys(fn ($ticket) => [$ticket->id => collect()]);
        if ($tickets->isEmpty() || !Schema::hasTable('activity_logs')) return $result;
        $reportIds = $tickets->filter(fn ($ticket) => $ticket instanceof Report)->pluck('id');
        $concernIds = $tickets->map(fn ($ticket) => $ticket instanceof Concern ? $ticket->id : $ticket->concern_id)->filter()->unique();
        $hasReportId = Schema::hasColumn('activity_logs', 'report_id');
        $hasConcernId = Schema::hasColumn('activity_logs', 'concern_id');
        $logs = ActivityLog::where(function ($query) use ($reportIds, $concernIds, $hasReportId, $hasConcernId) {
            $query->whereRaw('1 = 0');
            if ($hasReportId && $reportIds->isNotEmpty()) {
                $query->orWhere(fn ($q) => $q->where('action', 'report_reopened')->whereIn('report_id', $reportIds));
            }
            if ($hasConcernId && $concernIds->isNotEmpty()) {
                $query->orWhere(fn ($q) => $q->where('action', 'concern_reopened')->whereIn('concern_id', $concernIds));
            }
        })->orderBy('id')->get();
        $reportLogs = $logs->where('action', 'report_reopened')->groupBy('report_id');
        $concernLogs = $logs->where('action', 'concern_reopened')->groupBy('concern_id');
        foreach ($tickets as $ticket) {
            $concernId = $ticket instanceof Concern ? $ticket->id : $ticket->concern_id;
            $own = $ticket instanceof Report ? $reportLogs->get($ticket->id, collect()) : collect();
            $events = collect();
            foreach ($concernLogs->get($concernId, collect()) as $log) {
                if ($entry = $this->entry($log, $ticket)) $events->put('concern:'.$log->id, $entry);
            }
            $paired = [];
            foreach ($own as $log) {
                $entry = $this->entry($log, $ticket);
                if (!$entry) continue;
                $match = $events->search(function ($candidate, $key) use ($entry, $paired) {
                    if (!str_starts_with($key, 'concern:') || isset($paired[$key])
                        || $candidate['actor'] !== $entry['actor'] || $candidate['reason'] !== $entry['reason']) return false;
                    if ($candidate['resolved_at'] && $entry['resolved_at']) return $candidate['resolved_at']->equalTo($entry['resolved_at']);
                    // Legacy snapshots can omit the resolution timestamp.
                    return abs($candidate['reopened_at']->getTimestamp() - $entry['reopened_at']->getTimestamp()) <= 30;
                });
                if ($match !== false) {
                    $paired[$match] = true;
                    if (!$events[$match]['resolved_at'] && $entry['resolved_at']) {
                        $events->put($match, array_replace($events[$match], ['resolved_at' => $entry['resolved_at']]));
                    }
                } else {
                    $events->put('report:'.$log->id, $entry);
                }
            }
            $result->put($ticket->id, $events->map(fn ($entry, $key) => [
                'key' => $key, 'log_id' => $entry['log_id'], 'resolved_at' => $entry['resolved_at'], 'reopened_at' => $entry['reopened_at'],
            ])->values());
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function entry(ActivityLog $log, Concern|Report $ticket): ?array
    {
        $saved = $log->old_values ?? [];
        if (strtolower($saved['status'] ?? 'Resolved') !== 'resolved') return null;
        if ($this->normalize($saved['title'] ?? $ticket->title) !== $this->normalize($ticket->title)
            || $this->normalize($saved['location'] ?? $ticket->location) !== $this->normalize($ticket->location)) return null;
        return ['log_id' => $log->id, 'resolved_at' => $this->date($saved['resolved_at'] ?? null), 'reopened_at' => $log->created_at,
            'actor' => $log->user_id, 'reason' => $log->metadata['reason'] ?? $log->description];
    }

    private function normalize(?string $value): string
    {
        return strtolower(trim((string) $value));
    }

    private function date($value): ?Carbon
    {
        if (!$value) return null;
        try { return Carbon::parse($value)->setTimezone(config('app.timezone', 'UTC')); } catch (\Throwable) { return null; }
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Services/UserImportFile.php */

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Shuchkin\SimpleXLSX;
use ZipArchive;

class UserImportFile
{
    private const MAX_ROWS = 10000;
    private const MAX_COLUMNS = 100;
    private const MAX_EXPANDED_BYTES = 20 * 1024 * 1024;

    public static function rules(): array
    {
        return ['required', 'file', 'max:2048', 'extensions:csv,txt,xlsx',
            'mimetypes:text/plain,text/csv,text/tab-separated-values,application/csv,application/vnd.ms-excel,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet,application/zip'];
    }

    public function rows(UploadedFile $file, bool $masterlist, bool $allSheets): array
    {
        Validator::make(['file' => $file], ['file' => self::rules()])->validate();
        $rows = [];
        if (strtolower($file->getClientOriginalExtension()) === 'xlsx') {
            $this->checkWorkbook($file->getRealPath());
            $xlsx = SimpleXLSX::parse($file->getRealPath());
            if (!$xlsx) {
                $this->reject('The workbook is invalid. Please upload a valid XLSX file.');
            }
            $sheets = $allSheets ? array_keys($xlsx->sheetNames()) : [0];
            foreach ($sheets as $index) {
                $dimension = $xlsx->dimension($index);
                if ($dimension[0] > self::MAX_COLUMNS || $dimension[1] > self::MAX_ROWS) {
                    $this->reject('Imports may contain at most 10,000 rows and 100 columns.');
                }
                $sheetRows = [];
                foreach ($xlsx->readRows($index) as $row) {
                    $this->append($sheetRows, $row);
                }
                if ($allSheets) {
                    $sheetRows = StudentMasterlistRows::normalize($sheetRows);
                    if ($rows !== []) {
                        array_shift($sheetRows);
                    }
                }
                foreach ($sheetRows as $row) {
                    $this->append($rows, $row);
                }
            }
        } else {
            $content = file_get_contents($file->getRealPath());
            // Treat CSV/TXT as text data only; reject binary files and embedded code.
            if (preg_match('/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F]|<\?(?:php|=)|<script\b/i', $content)) {
                $this->reject('The import must contain plain CSV or tab-separated text.');
            }
            $handle = fopen($file->getRealPath(), 'r');
            try {
                while (($row = fgetcsv($handle, 0, $masterlist ? "\t" : ',')) !== false) {
                    $this->append($rows, $row);
                }
            } finally {
                fclose($handle);
            }
            if ($allSheets) {
                $rows = StudentMasterlistRows::normalize($rows);
            }
        }
        if (count($rows) < 2) {
            $this->reject('The import must contain a header and at least one data row.');
        }
        return $rows;
    }

    private function append(array &$rows, array $row): void
    {
        if (count($rows) >= self::MAX_ROWS || count($row) > self::MAX_COLUMNS) {
            $this->reject('Imports may contain at most 10,000 rows and 100 columns.');
        }
        $rows[] = $row;
    }

    private function checkWorkbook(string $path): void
    {
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($path) !== true) {
            $this->reject('The workbook is invalid. Please upload a valid XLSX file.');
        }
        try {
            if ($zip->numFiles > 1000 || $zip->locateName('[Content_Types].xml') === false
                || $zip->locateName('xl/workbook.xml') === false) {
                $this->reject('The XLSX workbook structure is invalid or too large.');
            }
            $bytes = 0;
            for ($index = 0; $index < $zip->numFiles; $index++) {
                $entry = $zip->statIndex($index);
                $bytes += $entry['size'];
                if ($bytes > self::MAX_EXPANDED_BYTES) {
                    $this->reject('The expanded workbook exceeds the 20 MB limit.');
                }
                if (preg_match('~(?:vbaProject\.bin$|(?:^|/)embeddings/|(?:^|/)externalLinks/)~i', $entry['name'])) {
                    $this->reject('Workbooks with macros, embedded objects or external links are not supported.');
                }
                if (preg_match('/\.(xml|rels)$/i', $entry['name'])
                    && preg_match('/<!DOCTYPE|<!ENTITY/i', $zip->getFromIndex($index))) {
                    $this->reject('Workbook XML declarations are not supported.');
                }
            }
        } finally {
            $zip->close();
        }
    }

    private function reject(string $message): never
    {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages(['file' => $message]);
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Support/BudgetApprovalSchema.php */

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class BudgetApprovalSchema
{
    private const COLUMNS = [
        'budget_amount',
        'budget_status',
        'budget_requested_by',
        'budget_requested_at',
        'budget_reviewed_by',
        'budget_reviewed_at',
        'budget_rejection_reason',
    ];

    public static function ensure(): void
    {
        foreach (['reports', 'concerns'] as $tableName) {
            $missing = array_values(array_filter(
                self::COLUMNS,
                fn (string $column): bool => ! Schema::hasColumn($tableName, $column)
            ));

            if ($missing === []) {
                continue;
            }

            Schema::table($tableName, function (Blueprint $table) use ($missing) {
                foreach ($missing as $column) {
                    match ($column) {
                        'budget_amount' => $table->decimal($column, 12, 2)->nullable(),
                        'budget_status' => $table->string($column, 20)->nullable(),
                        'budget_requested_by', 'budget_reviewed_by' => $table->unsignedBigInteger($column)->nullable(),
                        'budget_requested_at', 'budget_reviewed_at' => $table->timestamp($column)->nullable(),
                        'budget_rejection_reason' => $table->text($column)->nullable(),
                    };
                }
            });
        }
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Support/ConcernDecision.php */

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use App\Models\User;

class ConcernDecision
{
    public static function canResolve(User $user, ?string $priority, bool $hazard): bool
    {
        return self::canDecide($user, $priority, $hazard);
    }

    public static function canDecide(User $user, ?string $priority, bool $hazard): bool
    {
        return $user->isSystemAdministrator() || $user->role !== 'school_admin' || $priority === 'urgent' || $hazard;
    }

    public static function authorizeSchoolDecision(User $user, ?string $priority, bool $hazard): void
    {
        abort_unless(self::canDecide($user, $priority, $hazard), 403, 'School Administrators can decide only urgent and safety-hazard concerns.');
    }
}


/* FILE: app/Support/OpaquePageUrl.php */

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Encryption\DecryptException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Crypt;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class OpaquePageUrl
{
    public function path(string $uri): string
    {
        return '/'.$this->encode($uri);
    }

    public function encode(string $uri): string
    {
        if (! $this->isSafeLocalUri($uri)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Only local application paths can be made opaque.');
        }

        $encrypted = Crypt::encryptString($uri);

        return rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($encrypted), '+/', '-_'), '=');
    }

    public function decode(string $token): ?string
    {
        if (! preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/', $token)) {
            return null;
        }

        $padding = (4 - strlen($token) % 4) % 4;
        $encoded = strtr($token.str_repeat('=', $padding), '-_', '+/');
        $encrypted = base64_decode($encoded, true);

        if ($encrypted === false) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            $uri = Crypt::decryptString($encrypted);
        } catch (DecryptException) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->isSafeLocalUri($uri) ? $uri : null;
    }

    private function isSafeLocalUri(string $uri): bool
    {
        if ($uri === '' || strlen($uri) > 4096 || ! Str::startsWith($uri, '/')) {
            return false;
        }

        if (Str::startsWith($uri, ['//', '/api/'])
            || preg_match('#^/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{80,}(?:\?|$)#', $uri)
            || str_contains($uri, '\\')) {
            return false;
        }

        $parts = parse_url($uri);

        return $parts !== false
            && ! isset($parts['scheme'])
            && ! isset($parts['host'])
            && ! isset($parts['user'])
            && ! isset($parts['pass']);
    }
}

        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withProviders([
        \App\Providers\RateLimitServiceProvider::class,

        __DIR__.'/../app/Console/Commands',
    ])
    ->withSchedule(function (Schedule $schedule): void {

        $schedule->command('concerns:send-follow-ups')->daily();

            ->dailyAt(config('welcome-emails.send_at', '00:10'))
            ->timezone(config('welcome-emails.timezone', 'UTC'))
            ->withoutOverlapping();
        
        // Database backup every 15 minutes (free-tier friendly)

            ->everyFifteenMinutes()
            ->withoutOverlapping()
            ->runInBackground();
    })

        // Register security headers middleware globally (OWASP A6)

        $middleware->appendToGroup('web', EnforceSingleSession::class);

        // Ensure users complete first-login password setup
        $middleware->appendToGroup('web', EnsurePasswordChanged::class);

        // Hide descriptive page paths for every authenticated role. The
        // destination route still runs its original authorization middleware.
        $middleware->appendToGroup('web', UseOpaquePageUrls::class);

        $middleware->prependToGroup('api', ApiRequestContext::class);
        $middleware->appendToGroup('api', DatabaseTransaction::class);
        $middleware->appendToGroup('api', BlockSuspiciousQuery::class);
        $middleware->appendToGroup('api', EnforceApiResourceLimits::class);
        $middleware->appendToGroup('api', ApiSecurityHeaders::class);

        ]);

                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);

    private function mergeIssues(?string $existingIssues): array
    {
        $issues = json_decode($existingIssues ?? '[]', true);
        $issues = is_array($issues) ? $issues : [];
        $issueProblemTypes = $this->issueProblemTypes();
        $foundIssues = [];

        $issues = collect($issues)
            ->map(function ($issue) use ($issueProblemTypes, &$foundIssues) {
                if (is_string($issue)) {
                    $issue = [
                        'name' => $issue,
                        'problem_types' => [],
                    ];
                }

                $name = trim((string) ($issue['name'] ?? ''));
                $existingProblemTypes = is_array($issue['problem_types'] ?? null) ? $issue['problem_types'] : [];
                $issueKey = strtolower($name);

                if (isset($issueProblemTypes[$issueKey])) {
                    $foundIssues[] = $issueKey;
                    $existingProblemTypes = collect($existingProblemTypes)
                        ->merge($issueProblemTypes[$issueKey])
                        ->map(fn ($problemType) => trim((string) $problemType))
                        ->filter()
                        ->unique()
                        ->values()
                        ->all();
                }

                return [
                    'name' => $name,
                    'problem_types' => $existingProblemTypes,
                ];
            })
            ->filter(fn ($issue) => $issue['name'] !== '')
            ->values()
            ->all();

        foreach ($issueProblemTypes as $issueName => $problemTypes) {
            if (in_array($issueName, $foundIssues, true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $issues[] = [
                'name' => $this->displayIssueName($issueName),
                'problem_types' => $problemTypes,
            ];
        }

        return $issues;
    }

    private function issueProblemTypes(): array
    {
        return [
            'internet connection' => ['No connection', 'Slow connection', 'Intermittent connection', 'Wi-Fi not showing', 'Router/access point issue'],
            'computer' => ['Not turning on', 'No display', 'Slow performance', 'Keyboard/mouse issue', 'Software issue'],

            'network/system access' => ['Cannot access system', 'Login issue', 'Account locked', 'LAN cable issue', 'Blocked website'],
        ];
    }

    private function displayIssueName(string $issueName): string
    {
        return match ($issueName) {
            'network/system access' => 'Network/System Access',
            default => ucwords($issueName),
        };
    }

        $types = DB::table('event_request_types')->pluck('id', 'name');

        DB::table('event_approval_chains')->whereNull('event_intended_user_id')->delete();
        if (DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql') {
            DB::statement('ALTER TABLE event_approval_chains ALTER COLUMN event_intended_user_id SET NOT NULL');
        }

        foreach ($intendedUsers as $code => $intendedUserId) {
            foreach ($types as $typeName => $requestTypeId) {
                $existing = DB::table('event_approval_chains')
                    ->where('event_intended_user_id', $intendedUserId)
                    ->where('event_request_type_id', $requestTypeId)
                    ->exists();
                if ($existing) continue;

                $roles = $code === 'shs'
                    ? ['principal_assistant', 'academic_head', 'school_admin']
                    : ($typeName === 'Academic'
                        ? ['program_head', 'academic_head', 'building_admin', 'school_admin']
                        : ['building_admin', 'school_admin']);

                DB::table('event_approval_chains')->insert([
                    'event_intended_user_id' => $intendedUserId,
                    'event_request_type_id' => $requestTypeId,
                    'approval_roles' => json_encode($roles),
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ]);
            }
        }

        if (DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql') {
            DB::statement('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS event_approval_chain_intended_type_unique ON event_approval_chains (event_intended_user_id, event_request_type_id)');
        }
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        // Keep the intended-user chains because existing requests may depend on them.
    }
};

    private function preserveOwnedRecords(string $table): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable($table) || ! Schema::hasColumn($table, 'user_id')) {
            return;
        }

        if (DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql') {
            DB::statement(sprintf('ALTER TABLE %s ALTER COLUMN user_id DROP NOT NULL', $table));
            DB::unprepared(sprintf(<<<'SQL'
DO $$
DECLARE fk_name text;
BEGIN
    FOR fk_name IN
        SELECT tc.constraint_name
        FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
        JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
          ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
         AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
        WHERE tc.table_schema = 'public'
          AND tc.table_name = '%s'
          AND tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
          AND kcu.column_name = 'user_id'

        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%s DROP CONSTRAINT %%I', fk_name);
    END LOOP;
END $$;
SQL, $table, $table));
            DB::statement(sprintf(
                'ALTER TABLE %s ADD CONSTRAINT %s_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL',
                $table,

        });

    private function backfillReporterSnapshots(): void
    {
        if (DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql') {
            $this->backfillPostgresTable('concerns', 'reporter_name');
            $this->backfillPostgresTable('reports', 'reported_by_name');

            return;
        }

        foreach ([['concerns', 'reporter_name'], ['reports', 'reported_by_name']] as [$table, $nameColumn]) {
            if (! Schema::hasTable($table) || ! Schema::hasColumn($table, $nameColumn)) {
                continue;
            }

            DB::table($table)
                ->whereNotNull('user_id')
                ->orderBy('id')
                ->chunkById(100, function ($records) use ($table, $nameColumn): void {
                    foreach ($records as $record) {
                        $user = DB::table('users')->where('id', $record->user_id)->first();
                        if (! $user) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        $values = [
                            $nameColumn => $user->name ?? 'Unknown',
                            'reporter_email' => $user->email ?? null,
                            'reporter_role' => $user->role ?? null,
                            'reporter_department' => $user->department ?? null,
                            'reporter_phone' => $user->phone ?? null,
                            'reporter_student_id' => $user->student_id ?? null,
                        ];

                        $values = array_filter(
                            $values,
                            fn ($value, $column) => Schema::hasColumn($table, $column)
                                && $record->{$column} === null,
                            ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH
                        );

                        if ($values !== []) {
                            DB::table($table)->where('id', $record->id)->update($values);
                        }
                    }
                });
        }
    }

    private function backfillPostgresTable(string $table, string $nameColumn): void
    {
        if (! Schema::hasTable($table) || ! Schema::hasColumn($table, $nameColumn)) {
            return;
        }

        $hasActivityHistory = Schema::hasTable('activity_logs')
            && Schema::hasColumns('activity_logs', ['item_user_id', 'action', 'old_values', 'created_at']);

        $historicalValue = function (string $field) use ($table, $hasActivityHistory): string {
            if (! $hasActivityHistory) {
                return 'NULL';
            }

            return sprintf(
                "(SELECT log.old_values->>'%s' FROM activity_logs log WHERE log.item_user_id = records.user_id AND log.action = 'user_updated' AND log.created_at >= records.created_at AND log.old_values->>'%s' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY log.created_at ASC LIMIT 1)",
                $field,
                $field
            );
        };

        $assignments = [
            $nameColumn => "COALESCE(records.{$nameColumn}, {$historicalValue('name')}, users.name, 'Unknown')",
            'reporter_email' => "COALESCE(records.reporter_email, {$historicalValue('email')}, users.email)",
            'reporter_role' => "COALESCE(records.reporter_role, {$historicalValue('role')}, users.role)",
            'reporter_department' => "COALESCE(records.reporter_department, {$historicalValue('department')}, users.department)",
            'reporter_phone' => "COALESCE(records.reporter_phone, {$historicalValue('phone')}, users.phone)",
            'reporter_student_id' => "COALESCE(records.reporter_student_id, {$historicalValue('student_id')}, users.student_id)",
        ];

        $assignments = array_filter(
            $assignments,
            fn ($value, $column) => Schema::hasColumn($table, $column),
            ARRAY_FILTER_USE_BOTH
        );

        if ($assignments === []) {
            return;
        }

        $setSql = collect($assignments)
            ->map(fn ($expression, $column) => $column.' = '.$expression)
            ->implode(', ');

        DB::statement("UPDATE {$table} records SET {$setSql} FROM users WHERE users.id = records.user_id");
    }

    private function protectReporterSnapshots(): void
    {
        if (DB::getDriverName() !== 'pgsql') {
            return;
        }

        DB::unprepared(<<<'SQL'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_concern_reporter_snapshot()
RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    IF OLD.reporter_name IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.reporter_name := OLD.reporter_name; END IF;
    IF OLD.reporter_email IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.reporter_email := OLD.reporter_email; END IF;
    IF OLD.reporter_role IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.reporter_role := OLD.reporter_role; END IF;
    IF OLD.reporter_department IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.reporter_department := OLD.reporter_department; END IF;
    IF OLD.reporter_phone IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.reporter_phone := OLD.reporter_phone; END IF;
    IF OLD.reporter_student_id IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.reporter_student_id := OLD.reporter_student_id; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS concerns_preserve_reporter_snapshot ON public.concerns;
CREATE TRIGGER concerns_preserve_reporter_snapshot
BEFORE UPDATE ON public.concerns
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.preserve_concern_reporter_snapshot();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_report_reporter_snapshot()

/* Admin Pages JavaScript */

// Tab switching
function switchTab(tab) {
    // Hide all tab contents
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
    
    // Show selected tab
    document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).classList.add('active');
    event.target.classList.add('active');
}

// Edit user modal functions
function openEditModal(id, name, email, role) {
    document.getElementById('editUserId').value = id;
    document.getElementById('editName').value = name;
    document.getElementById('editEmail').value = email;
    document.getElementById('editRole').value = role;
    document.getElementById('editForm').action = '/admin/users/' + id;
    document.getElementById('editModal').classList.add('show');
}

function closeEditModal() {
    document.getElementById('editModal').classList.remove('show');
}

// Close modal when clicking outside
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const editModal = document.getElementById('editModal');
    if (editModal) {
        editModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (e.target === this) {
                closeEditModal();
            }
        });
    }
});
