<?php

use App\Http\Controllers\AuthController;
use App\Http\Controllers\CategoryController;
use App\Http\Controllers\ConcernController;
use App\Http\Controllers\EventRequestController;
use App\Http\Controllers\PushNotificationController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/*
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| API Routes - JWT Authentication
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
*/

Route::middleware(['api.context', 'api.query.guard', 'api.resource', 'api.security'])->group(function () {
    // Health check
    Route::get('/health', function () {
        return response()->json(['status' => 'healthy', 'timestamp' => now()->toIso8601String()]);
    });

    // Auth - Rate limited (OWASP A6: Rate Limiting - 5 attempts per minute)
    Route::middleware('throttle:5,1')->group(function () {
        Route::post('/auth/login', [AuthController::class, 'apiLogin']);
        Route::post('/auth/register', [AuthController::class, 'apiRegister']);
    });

    // Auth routes with JWT middleware
    Route::post('/auth/logout', [AuthController::class, 'apiLogout'])->middleware('jwt.auth');
    Route::get('/auth/user', [AuthController::class, 'apiUser'])->middleware('jwt.auth');
    Route::post('/auth/refresh', [AuthController::class, 'apiRefreshToken'])->middleware('jwt.auth');

    // Categories - Public read, Admin write
    Route::get('/categories', [CategoryController::class, 'apiIndex']);
    Route::middleware(['jwt.auth', 'role:mis,admin'])->group(function () {
        Route::post('/categories', [CategoryController::class, 'apiStore']);
        Route::delete('/categories/{category}', [CategoryController::class, 'apiDestroy']);
    });

    // Protected routes - JWT authentication with rate limiting
    Route::middleware(['jwt.auth', 'throttle:api'])->group(function () {

    // Push Notifications
    Route::post('/push/subscribe', [PushNotificationController::class, 'subscribe']);
    Route::post('/push/unsubscribe', [PushNotificationController::class, 'unsubscribe']);
    Route::get('/push/status', [PushNotificationController::class, 'status']);

    // Concerns - User can only access their own
    Route::get('/concerns', [ConcernController::class, 'apiIndex']);
    Route::post('/concerns', [ConcernController::class, 'apiStore'])->middleware('throttle:submissions');
    Route::get('/concerns/{id}', [ConcernController::class, 'apiShow']);
    Route::get('/concerns/{id}/edit-data', [ConcernController::class, 'apiEditData']);
    Route::put('/concerns/{id}', [ConcernController::class, 'apiUpdate']);
    Route::delete('/concerns/{id}', [ConcernController::class, 'apiDestroy'])->middleware('throttle:deletes');

    // Events
    Route::get('/events', [EventRequestController::class, 'apiIndex']);
    Route::post('/events', [EventRequestController::class, 'apiStore'])->middleware('throttle:submissions');
    Route::get('/events/{id}', [EventRequestController::class, 'apiShow']);

        // Admin routes - Additional role-based protection
        Route::middleware('role:mis,admin')->group(function () {
            Route::get('/admin/dashboard', [AuthController::class, 'apiDashboard']);
        });
    });
});

Route::middleware(['auth', 'throttle:notifications'])->group(function () {
    // Unread count endpoint - MUST be before {id} routes to avoid conflicts
    Route::get('/notifications/unread-count', function () {
        try {
            if (!auth()->check()) {
                return response()->json(['count' => 0], 401);
            }
            $count = auth()->user()->unreadNotifications()->count();
            return response()->json(['count' => $count], 200, [], JSON_NUMERIC_CHECK);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            \Log::error('Unread notification count error: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return response()->json(['count' => 0, 'error' => $e->getMessage()], 500);
        }
    })->name('notifications.unreadCount');
    
    Route::get('/notifications/{id}', [NotificationController::class, 'show'])->name('notifications.show');
    Route::post('/notifications/{id}/read', [NotificationController::class, 'markAsRead'])->name('notifications.markRead');
    Route::post('/notifications/{id}/unread', [NotificationController::class, 'markAsUnread'])->name('notifications.markUnread');
    Route::get('/notifications/{id}/read', [NotificationController::class, 'read'])->name('notifications.read');
    Route::delete('/notifications/{id}', [NotificationController::class, 'destroy'])->name('notifications.destroy');
});

/* OTP VERIFICATION */
Route::get('/verify-otp', function () {
    if (! session('otp_user')) {
        return redirect('/')->with('error', 'Session expired. Please login again.');
    }

    $user = \App\Models\User::find(session('otp_user'));
    $expiresAt = $user?->otp_expires_at
        ? \Carbon\Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m-d H:i:s', $user->otp_expires_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'), 'UTC')->getTimestampMs()
        : 0;

    return view('auth.verify-otp', [
        'otpRemainingMilliseconds' => max(0, $expiresAt - now()->getTimestampMs()),
    ]);
});

Route::post('/verify-otp', [AuthController::class, 'verifyOtp']);

/* ROLE-PREFIXED URL ALIASES - Map role-specific URLs to admin controllers
   Only GET routes — form submissions continue to use /admin/* paths.
   Role → prefix:
     mis               → /mis
     building_admin    → /building-admin
     school_admin      → /school-admin
     academic_head     → /academic-head
     program_head      → /program-head
     principal_assistant → /principal-assistant
     admin             → /system-admin (handled by superadmin panel above for superadmin,
                         but for role=admin users the middleware redirects /admin → /system-admin)
*/
Route::middleware(['auth', 'admin', 'throttle:admin'])->group(function () {
    foreach ([
        'mis'                 => 'mis',
        'building-admin'      => 'building_admin',
        'school-admin'        => 'school_admin',
        'academic-head'       => 'academic_head',
        'program-head'        => 'program_head',
        'principal-assistant' => 'principal_assistant',
    ] as $prefix => $role) {
        $dashboardController = $role === 'mis' ? AdminController::class : DashboardController::class;
        Route::get("/{$prefix}",              [$dashboardController, 'index'])->name("{$prefix}.dashboard");
        Route::get("/{$prefix}/reports",      [AdminController::class, 'reports'])->name("{$prefix}.reports");
        Route::get("/{$prefix}/analytics",    [AdminController::class, 'analytics'])->name("{$prefix}.analytics");
        Route::get("/{$prefix}/management",   [\App\Http\Controllers\ManagementController::class, 'index'])->name("{$prefix}.management");
        Route::get("/{$prefix}/events",       [EventRequestController::class, 'adminIndex'])->name("{$prefix}.events");
        Route::get("/{$prefix}/mis-tasks",    [AdminController::class, 'misTasks'])->name("{$prefix}.mis-tasks");
        // User Management belongs exclusively to the System Administrator.
        if ($role !== 'mis') {
            Route::get("/{$prefix}/users", [AdminController::class, 'users'])->name("{$prefix}.users");
            Route::get("/{$prefix}/users/{uuid}/edit", [AdminController::class, 'editUser'])->name("{$prefix}.users.edit");
        }
        Route::get("/{$prefix}/logs",         [AdminController::class, 'logs'])->name("{$prefix}.logs");
    }
});

/* EVENTS */
Route::get('/events', function () {
    $events = Event::all()->map(function ($event) {
        return [
            'title' => $event->title,
            'start' => $event->date,
        ];
    });

    // Also get approved event requests
    $eventRequests = \App\Models\EventRequest::where('status', 'Approved')->get()->map(function ($er) {
        return [
            'title' => $er->title,
            'start' => $er->event_date,
        ];
    });

    return $events->concat($eventRequests)->values();
});

/* FILE: tests/Feature/AdminAnalyticsTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Concern;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AdminAnalyticsTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected User $adminUser;
    protected Category $category;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Create an admin user
        $this->adminUser = User::create([
            'name' => 'Admin User',
            'role' => 'mis',
            'email' => 'admin@novaliches.sti.edu.ph',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
        ]);

        // Create a category
        $this->category = Category::create([
            'name' => 'Electrical',
        ]);
    }

    /** @test */
    public function it_displays_analytics_page_for_admin_users()
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->adminUser)
            ->get('/admin/analytics');

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertViewIs('admin.analytics');
    }

    /** @test */
    public function it_includes_top_issue_in_location_statistics()
    {
        // Create multiple concerns for the same location with different titles
        Concern::create([
            'user_id' => $this->adminUser->id,
            'category' => $this->category->id,
            'location' => 'Room 101',
            'title' => 'Broken Light',
            'description' => 'Light is broken',
            'status' => 'Resolved',
            'cost' => 100,
        ]);

        Concern::create([
            'user_id' => $this->adminUser->id,
            'category' => $this->category->id,
            'location' => 'Room 101',
            'title' => 'Broken Light',
            'description' => 'Another broken light',
            'status' => 'Resolved',
            'cost' => 150,
        ]);

        Concern::create([
            'user_id' => $this->adminUser->id,
            'category' => $this->category->id,
            'location' => 'Room 101',
            'title' => 'Faulty Socket',
            'description' => 'Socket not working',
            'status' => 'Resolved',
            'cost' => 50,
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->adminUser)
            ->get('/admin/analytics');

        $response->assertStatus(200);

        // Verify the view has location stats with top_issue
        $locationStats = $response->viewData('locationStats');
        
        $this->assertNotNull($locationStats);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $locationStats->count());

        $room101Stats = $locationStats->firstWhere('location', 'Room 101');
        
        $this->assertNotNull($room101Stats);
        $this->assertEquals('Room 101', $room101Stats['location']);
        $this->assertEquals(3, $room101Stats['count']);
        $this->assertEquals(300, $room101Stats['total_cost']);
        $this->assertEquals('Broken Light', $room101Stats['top_issue']); // Most common issue
    }

    /** @test */
    public function it_shows_various_issues_when_no_title_exists()
    {
        // Create concerns without titles
        Concern::create([
            'user_id' => $this->adminUser->id,
            'category' => $this->category->id,
            'location' => 'Room 202',
            'title' => null,
            'description' => 'Some issue',
            'status' => 'Resolved',
            'cost' => 100,
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->adminUser)
            ->get('/admin/analytics');

        $response->assertStatus(200);

        $locationStats = $response->viewData('locationStats');
        $room202Stats = $locationStats->firstWhere('location', 'Room 202');

        $this->assertNotNull($room202Stats);
        $this->assertEquals('Various Issues', $room202Stats['top_issue']);
    }

    /** @test */
    public function it_redirects_non_admin_users()
    {
        $studentUser = User::create([
            'name' => 'Student User',
            'role' => 'student',
            'email' => 'student@novaliches.sti.edu.ph',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($studentUser)
            ->get('/admin/analytics');

        $response->assertRedirect('/dashboard');
    }

    /** @test */
    public function it_requires_authentication()
    {
        $response = $this->get('/admin/analytics');

        $response->assertRedirect('/');
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/ArchiveAllUsersTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\AdminController;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\UserArchiveFolder;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ArchiveAllUsersTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->uuid('uuid');
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('email');
            $table->string('password');
            $table->string('role');
            $table->json('permissions')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_superadmin')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false);
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('archive_folder_id')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('user_archive_folders', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name')->unique();
            $table->text('description')->nullable();
            $table->integer('user_count')->default(0);
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('activity_logs', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('concern_id')->nullable();
            $table->string('action');
            $table->text('description');
            $table->string('ip_address')->nullable();
            $table->text('user_agent')->nullable();
            $table->json('old_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('new_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('metadata')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
    }

    private function account(string $role, array $attributes = []): User
    {
        return User::forceCreate(array_merge([
            'name' => 'Account',
            'email' => uniqid().'@example.com',
            'password' => 'unused',
            'role' => $role,
        ], $attributes));
    }

    public function test_archives_all_pages_and_roles_but_preserves_excluded_accounts(): void
    {
        $actor = $this->account('mis');
        $this->actingAs($actor);
        $superadmin = $this->account('mis', ['is_superadmin' => true]);
        $deleted = $this->account('student', ['is_deleted' => true]);
        $oldFolder = UserArchiveFolder::create(['name' => 'Old', 'user_count' => 1]);
        $alreadyArchived = $this->account('faculty', ['is_archived' => true, 'archive_folder_id' => $oldFolder->id]);
        foreach (range(1, 45) as $number) {
            $this->account($number % 2 ? 'student' : 'mis');
        }
        $request = Request::create('/admin/users/archive-all', 'POST', ['folder_name' => '2026-2027']);
        $request->headers->set('Accept', 'application/json');
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => $actor);
        $response = app(AdminController::class)->archiveAllUsers($request);
        $this->assertSame(45, $response->getData(true)['count']);
        $this->assertFalse((bool) $actor->fresh()->is_archived);
        $this->assertFalse((bool) $superadmin->fresh()->is_archived);
        $this->assertFalse((bool) User::withoutGlobalScopes()->find($deleted->id)->is_archived);
        $this->assertSame($oldFolder->id, $alreadyArchived->fresh()->archive_folder_id);
        $this->assertSame(45, UserArchiveFolder::where('name', '2026-2027')->first()->user_count);
        $this->assertSame(1, $oldFolder->fresh()->user_count);
        $again = app(AdminController::class)->archiveAllUsers($request);
        $this->assertSame(0, $again->getData(true)['count']);
    }

    public function test_requires_archive_permission(): void
    {
        $actor = $this->account('student');
        $request = Request::create('/admin/users/archive-all', 'POST', ['folder_name' => 'Archive']);
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => $actor);
        $this->expectException(\Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException::class);
        app(AdminController::class)->archiveAllUsers($request);
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/BudgetApprovalWorkflowTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\BudgetApprovalController;
use App\Http\Controllers\ReportController;
use App\Models\Concern;
use App\Models\Report;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class BudgetApprovalWorkflowTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Schema::dropAllTables();
        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->uuid('uuid')->nullable();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('email')->nullable();
            $table->string('password')->nullable();
            $table->string('role');
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false);
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('concerns', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->foreignId('user_id')->nullable();
            $table->string('title')->nullable();
            $table->string('status')->default('Assigned');
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('reports', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->foreignId('concern_id')->nullable();
            $table->foreignId('user_id')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('assigned_to')->nullable();
            $table->string('title')->nullable();
            $table->string('status')->default('Assigned');
            $table->softDeletes();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('activity_logs', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->foreignId('user_id')->nullable();
            $table->string('action');
            $table->text('description')->nullable();
            $table->foreignId('report_id')->nullable();
            $table->string('ip_address')->nullable();
            $table->text('user_agent')->nullable();
            $table->json('old_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('new_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('metadata')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('notifications', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->uuid('id')->primary();
            $table->string('type');
            $table->morphs('notifiable');
            $table->text('data');
            $table->timestamp('read_at')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });

    }

    public function test_school_administrator_approval_is_required_before_progress(): void
    {
        Schema::table('reports', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->string('severity')->default('urgent');
        });
        $buildingAdministrator = User::create([
            'name' => 'Building Administrator',
            'email' => 'building@example.test',
            'role' => 'building_admin',
        ]);
        $schoolAdministrator = User::create([
            'name' => 'School Administrator',
            'email' => 'school@example.test',
            'role' => User::ROLE_SCHOOL_ADMIN,
        ]);
        $concern = Concern::create([
            'user_id' => $buildingAdministrator->id,
            'title' => 'Repair laboratory air conditioner',
            'status' => 'Assigned',
        ]);
        $report = Report::create([
            'user_id' => $buildingAdministrator->id,
            'concern_id' => $concern->id,
            'title' => $concern->title,
            'status' => 'Assigned',
        ]);

        Auth::login($buildingAdministrator);
        $started = app(ReportController::class)->updateStatus(
            $this->jsonRequest(['status' => 'In Progress']),
            $report->id
        );
        $this->assertSame(200, $started->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame('In Progress', $report->refresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('In Progress', $concern->refresh()->status);

        $requested = app(BudgetApprovalController::class)->request(
            $this->jsonRequest(['budget_amount' => 12500]),
            $report->refresh()
        );
        $this->assertSame(200, $requested->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertTrue(Schema::hasColumns('reports', ['budget_amount', 'budget_status', 'budget_requested_by']));
        $this->assertTrue(Schema::hasColumns('concerns', ['budget_amount', 'budget_status', 'budget_requested_by']));
        $this->assertSame(Report::BUDGET_PENDING, $report->refresh()->budget_status);
        $this->assertSame(Report::BUDGET_PENDING, $concern->refresh()->budget_status);

        $blockedResolution = app(ReportController::class)->updateStatus(
            $this->jsonRequest(['status' => 'Resolved']),
            $report->id
        );
        $this->assertSame(422, $blockedResolution->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertTrue($blockedResolution->getData(true)['requires_budget_approval']);

        Auth::login($schoolAdministrator);
        $schoolBlocked = app(ReportController::class)->updateStatus(
            $this->jsonRequest(['status' => 'Resolved']),
            $report->id
        );
        $this->assertSame(422, $schoolBlocked->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertTrue($schoolBlocked->getData(true)['requires_budget_approval']);
        $approved = app(BudgetApprovalController::class)->approve($report->refresh());
        $this->assertSame(200, $approved->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertTrue($report->refresh()->hasApprovedBudget());
        $this->assertTrue($concern->refresh()->hasApprovedBudget());
        $this->assertSame($schoolAdministrator->id, $report->budget_reviewed_by);

        $layout = file_get_contents(resource_path('views/layouts/app.blade.php'));
        $reportsView = file_get_contents(resource_path('views/admin/reports.blade.php'));
        $approvalView = file_get_contents(resource_path('views/school-admin/budget-approvals.blade.php'));
        $adminController = file_get_contents(app_path('Http/Controllers/AdminController.php'));
        $route = app('router')->getRoutes()->match(Request::create('/school-admin/budget-approvals', 'GET'));
        $this->assertSame(BudgetApprovalController::class.'@index', $route->getActionName());
        $this->assertStringContainsString("route('school-admin.budget-approvals')", $layout);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Budget Approvals', $layout);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Approve budget', $reportsView);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('No budget requests found', $approvalView);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('assignReport(', $approvalView);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Archive budget report', $approvalView);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('View budget report', $approvalView);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Delete budget report', $approvalView);
        $this->assertStringContainsString("['admin', 'building_admin', 'school_admin', 'academic_head', 'mis']", $adminController);
    }

    public function test_decision_queues_and_priority_notifications_follow_responsibility(): void
    {
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::fake();
        Schema::table('reports', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->string('severity')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_safety_hazard')->default(false);
        });
        $school = User::create(['name' => 'School', 'role' => 'school_admin']);
        $system = User::create(['name' => 'System', 'role' => 'admin']);
        $building = User::create(['name' => 'Building', 'role' => 'building_admin']);
        $low = Report::create(['title' => 'Low', 'severity' => 'low']);
        $urgent = Report::create(['title' => 'Urgent', 'severity' => 'urgent']);
        $hazard = Report::create(['title' => 'Hazard', 'severity' => 'low', 'is_safety_hazard' => true]);
        $medium = Report::create(['title' => 'Medium', 'severity' => 'medium']);
        $unclassified = Report::create(['title' => 'Needs triage']);

        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing([$urgent->id, $hazard->id], Report::forDecisionQueue($school)->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame(5, Report::forDecisionQueue($system)->count());
        $this->assertSame(2, Report::forDecisionQueue($school, 'all')->count());
        $this->assertSame(5, Report::forDecisionQueue($building)->count());
        $school->forceFill(['permissions' => ['events']]);
        $this->assertTrue($school->canAccess('reports'));

        $notification = \App\Notifications\PriorityReviewNotification::class;
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::assertSentToTimes($school, $notification, 2);
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::assertSentToTimes($system, $notification, 1);
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::assertNotSentTo($building, $notification);
        $medium->update(['severity' => 'urgent']);
        $medium->update(['title' => 'Renamed urgent report']);
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::assertSentToTimes($school, $notification, 3);
    }

    public function test_school_is_restricted_but_system_can_resolve_all_priorities(): void
    {
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::fake();
        foreach (['reports', 'concerns'] as $name) {
            Schema::table($name, function (Blueprint $table) use ($name) {
                $table->string($name === 'reports' ? 'severity' : 'priority')->nullable();
                $table->boolean('is_safety_hazard')->default(false);
                $table->timestamp('resolved_at')->nullable();
                $table->text('resolution_notes')->nullable();
                $table->decimal('cost')->nullable();
                $table->string('damaged_part')->nullable();
                $table->string('replaced_part')->nullable();
            });
        }
        Schema::create('report_status_logs', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('report_id');
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('changed_by');
            $table->string('old_status');
            $table->string('new_status');
            $table->timestamp('changed_at');
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        $school = User::create(['name' => 'School', 'role' => 'school_admin']);
        $system = User::create(['name' => 'System', 'role' => 'admin']);
        $controller = app(ReportController::class);

        foreach ([['urgent', false], ['low', true], ['low', false], ['medium', false], ['high', false], [null, false]] as [$priority, $hazard]) {
            $concern = Concern::create(['title' => 'Repair', 'priority' => $priority, 'is_safety_hazard' => $hazard, 'status' => 'In Progress']);
            $report = Report::create(['concern_id' => $concern->id, 'severity' => $priority, 'is_safety_hazard' => $hazard, 'status' => 'In Progress']);
            if ($priority !== 'urgent' && ! $hazard) {
                Auth::login($school);
                foreach (['In Progress', 'Resolved'] as $status) {
                    $blocked = $controller->updateStatus($this->jsonRequest(['status' => $status]), $report->id);
                    $this->assertSame(403, $blocked->getStatusCode());
                }
                $blockedAssignment = app(\App\Http\Controllers\AdminController::class)->assignReport($this->jsonRequest([]), $report->id);
                $this->assertSame(403, $blockedAssignment->getStatusCode());
            }
            Auth::login($system);
            $result = $controller->updateStatus($this->jsonRequest(['status' => 'Resolved', 'resolution_notes' => 'Completed']), $report->id);
            $this->assertSame(200, $result->getStatusCode());
            $this->assertSame('Resolved', $report->refresh()->status);
            $this->assertSame('Resolved', $concern->refresh()->status);
            $this->assertNotNull($report->resolved_at);
        }
    }

    public function test_system_admin_can_assign_maintenance_and_technology_and_set_priority(): void
    {
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::fake();
        $this->mock(\App\Services\TicketHistoryService::class)->shouldReceive('renderFor')->andReturn('');
        $this->mock(\App\Services\AssetReplacementService::class)->shouldReceive('canRecordOnResolution')->andReturn(true);
        Schema::create('categories', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('maintenance_staff', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->softDeletes();
        });
        Schema::table('reports', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('category_id')->nullable();
            $table->timestamp('assigned_at')->nullable();
            $table->string('severity')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_safety_hazard')->default(false);
        });
        $maintenanceCategory = \App\Models\Category::create(['name' => 'Maintenance']);
        $technologyCategory = \App\Models\Category::create(['name' => 'Technology/Internet']);
        $staffId = \Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('maintenance_staff')->insertGetId(['name' => 'Maintenance']);
        $mis = User::create(['name' => 'MIS', 'role' => 'mis']);
        $controller = app(\App\Http\Controllers\AdminController::class);

        foreach (['admin', 'superadmin', 'mis'] as $role) {
            $system = User::create(['name' => 'System', 'role' => $role]);
            if ($role === 'mis') $system->forceFill(['is_superadmin' => true]);
            Auth::login($system);
            foreach ([[$maintenanceCategory, $staffId], [$technologyCategory, $mis->id]] as [$category, $assignee]) {
                $report = Report::create(['title' => 'Repair', 'category_id' => $category->id, 'status' => 'Pending']);
                $result = $controller->assignReport($this->jsonRequest(['assigned_to' => $assignee, 'priority' => 'high']), $report->id);
                $this->assertSame(200, $result->getStatusCode());
                $this->assertSame('Assigned', $report->refresh()->status);
                $this->assertEquals($assignee, $report->assigned_to);
                $this->assertSame('high', $report->severity);
                $result = $controller->setReportPriority($this->jsonRequest(['priority' => 'safety_hazard']), $report->id);
                $this->assertSame(200, $result->getStatusCode());
                $this->assertTrue($report->refresh()->is_safety_hazard);
                $this->assertSame('urgent', $report->severity);
                $progress = app(ReportController::class)->apiShow($report->id);
                $this->assertSame(200, $progress->getStatusCode());
                $this->assertTrue($progress->getData(true)['report']['can_resolve_decision']);
            }
        }
    }

    private function jsonRequest(array $data): Request
    {
        $request = Request::create('/test', 'POST', $data);
        $request->headers->set('Accept', 'application/json');
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => Auth::user());

        return $request;
    }

/* FILE: tests/Feature/BudgetQueueActionsTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\BudgetApprovalController;
use App\Models\Category;

class BudgetQueueActionsTest extends TestCase
{
    private User $schoolAdmin;

    private Report $report;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Schema::dropAllTables();
        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->uuid('uuid');
            $table->string('name');

        });

            $table->timestamps();
        });

            $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id');

            'status' => 'Resolved', 'budget_amount' => 500, 'budget_status' => 'approved',

        $this->actingAs($this->schoolAdmin);

    public function test_view_reuses_report_modal_and_includes_budget_information(): void
    {
        $this->get(route('school-admin.budget-approvals.details', $this->report->id), ['X-Requested-With' => 'XMLHttpRequest'])
            ->assertOk()->assertSee('Report Details')->assertSee('Budget request')
            ->assertSee('PHP 500.00')->assertSee('Room 303')->assertSee('Room is too hot');
    }

    public function test_archiving_uses_report_archives_and_restore_returns_item_to_active_queue(): void
    {
        $this->postJson(route('reports.archive', $this->report))->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('success', true);
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->queue());
        $this->assertSame([$this->report->id], $this->queue('archives')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->postJson(route('reports.restore', $this->report))->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('success', true);
        $this->assertSame([$this->report->id], $this->queue()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame('approved', $this->report->fresh()->budget_status);
    }

    public function test_deleting_moves_to_deleted_and_can_be_restored_without_losing_budget(): void
    {
        $this->deleteJson(route('reports.destroy', $this->report))->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('success', true);
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->queue());
        $this->assertSame([$this->report->id], $this->queue('deleted')->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->get(route('school-admin.budget-approvals.details', $this->report->id), ['X-Requested-With' => 'XMLHttpRequest'])->assertOk()->assertSee('PHP 500.00');
        $this->postJson(route('school-admin.budget-approvals.restore-deleted', $this->report->id))->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('success', true);
        $this->assertSame([$this->report->id], $this->queue()->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertFalse($this->report->fresh()->school_admin_deleted);
        $this->assertSame('approved', $this->report->fresh()->budget_status);
    }

    public function test_assigned_unresolved_report_cannot_be_deleted(): void
    {
        $this->report->update(['status' => 'In Progress', 'assigned_to' => $this->schoolAdmin->id]);
        $this->deleteJson(route('reports.destroy', $this->report))->assertJsonPath('success', false);
        $this->assertFalse($this->report->fresh()->is_deleted);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->queue());
    }

    public function test_archive_for_another_user_does_not_hide_item_from_current_queue(): void
    {
        $other = $this->makeUser('school_admin');
        $this->report->archivedByUsers()->attach($other->id);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->queue());
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->queue('archives'));
    }

    public function test_school_admin_routes_reject_other_roles_and_non_budget_reports(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->makeUser('mis'));
        $this->getJson(route('school-admin.budget-approvals.details', $this->report->id))->assertForbidden();
        $this->postJson(route('school-admin.budget-approvals.restore-deleted', $this->report->id))->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($this->schoolAdmin);
        $this->report->update(['budget_status' => null]);
        $this->getJson(route('school-admin.budget-approvals.details', $this->report->id))->assertNotFound();
        $this->postJson(route('school-admin.budget-approvals.restore-deleted', $this->report->id))->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_search_and_status_filters_still_apply_to_archived_budgets(): void
    {
        $this->postJson(route('reports.archive', $this->report))->assertOk();
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->queue('archives', ['status' => 'approved', 'search' => 'air conditioner']));
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->queue('archives', ['status' => 'pending']));
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->queue('archives', ['search' => 'another room']));
    }

    public function test_a_revised_budget_reappears_for_review_after_the_previous_request_was_archived(): void
    {
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification::fake();
        $this->report->update(['budget_status' => 'rejected', 'status' => 'In Progress']);
        $this->postJson(route('reports.archive', $this->report))->assertOk();
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->queue());
        $this->actingAs($this->makeUser('building_admin'))->postJson(route('reports.budget.request', $this->report), ['budget_amount' => 600])
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('budget_status', 'pending');
        $this->actingAs($this->schoolAdmin);
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->queue());
        $this->assertFalse($this->report->fresh()->school_admin_archived);
    }

    private function queue(string $view = 'active', array $filters = [])
    {
        $request = Request::create('/school-admin/budget-approvals', 'GET', array_merge(['view' => $view], $filters));

        return app(BudgetApprovalController::class)->index($request)->getData()['budgets']->getCollection();
    }

    private function makeUser(string $role): User
    {
        return User::create(['name' => $role, 'email' => uniqid().'@example.com', 'role' => $role]);
    }

/* FILE: tests/Feature/DatabaseTransactionTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Middleware\DatabaseTransaction;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class DatabaseTransactionTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Schema::dropIfExists('transaction_test_records');
        Schema::create('transaction_test_records', function (Blueprint $table): void {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('value');
        });
    }

    public function test_successful_json_response_commits_even_when_session_has_error_flash(): void
    {
        $request = Request::create('/test-update', 'PUT');
        $request->setLaravelSession(app('session')->driver());
        $request->session()->flash('error', 'Unrelated message from an earlier workflow.');

        $response = (new DatabaseTransaction)->handle($request, function (): JsonResponse {
            DB::table('transaction_test_records')->insert(['value' => 'saved']);

            return response()->json(['success' => true]);
        });

        $this->assertTrue($response->getData(true)['success']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('transaction_test_records', ['value' => 'saved']);
    }
}

/* FILE: tests/Feature/FacilityApprovalProgressTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\EventRequestController;
use App\Models\EventRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\FacilityApprovalProgress;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Blade;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class FacilityApprovalProgressTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Schema::dropAllTables();
        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->uuid('uuid'); $table->string('name'); $table->string('email');
            $table->string('role'); $table->string('password')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false); $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false); $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('event_requests', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id'); $table->string('status')->default('Pending');
            $table->string('request_type')->nullable(); $table->string('education_level')->nullable();
            $table->json('approval_route')->nullable(); $table->json('approval_history')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedInteger('approval_level')->default(1);
            foreach (['', '_level_1', '_level_2', '_level_3'] as $suffix) {
                $table->unsignedBigInteger('approved_by'.$suffix)->nullable(); $table->timestamp('approved_at'.$suffix)->nullable();
            }
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false); $table->timestamps();
            $table->date('event_date')->nullable();
            foreach (['student', 'faculty', 'building_admin', 'school_admin', 'academic_head', 'program_head', 'mis', 'maintenance'] as $role) {
                $table->boolean($role.'_archived')->default(false);
            }
        });
    }

    public function test_pending_approval_page_loads_existing_requests_without_changing_approval_history(): void
    {
        $approver = User::forceCreate(['name' => 'School Approver', 'email' => 'approver@example.com', 'role' => 'school_admin']);
        $event = $this->event(['user_id' => $approver->id, 'event_date' => now()->addDays(2)->toDateString()]);
        $event->save();
        $before = $event->fresh()->getAttributes();
        $this->actingAs($approver);

        $view = app(EventRequestController::class)->adminIndex(Request::create('/events/admin'));

        $this->assertSame('admin.events', $view->name());
        $this->assertSame('pending', $view->getData()['viewType']);
        $this->assertSame([$event->id], $view->getData()['requests']->pluck('id')->all());
        $this->assertSame($before, $event->fresh()->getAttributes());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('3 / 4', $this->renderTracker($view->getData()['requests']->first()));
    }

    private function event(array $overrides = []): EventRequest
    {
        return new EventRequest(array_merge(['status' => 'Pending', 'approval_level' => 4,
            'request_type' => 'Non-Academic',
            'approval_route' => ['program_head', 'academic_head', 'building_admin', 'school_admin'],
            'approval_history' => [
                ['level' => 1, 'approver_id' => 11, 'approver' => 'Program approver', 'at' => '2026-10-22 10:00:00'],
                ['level' => 2, 'approver_id' => 12, 'approver' => 'Academic approver', 'at' => '2026-10-22 10:10:00'],
                ['level' => 3, 'approver_id' => 13, 'approver' => 'Building approver', 'at' => '2026-10-22 10:20:00'],
            ]], $overrides));
    }

    private function renderTracker(EventRequest $event): string
    {
        return Blade::render('<x-request-progress-tracker :request="$event" title="Approval Progress" />', compact('event'));
    }

    private function renderPdf(EventRequest $event): string
    {
        $event->save();
        $html = '';
        $pdf = \Mockery::mock(\Barryvdh\DomPDF\PDF::class);
        $pdf->shouldReceive('setPaper')->once()->with('a4', 'portrait')->andReturnSelf();
        $pdf->shouldReceive('download')->once()->with('event-request-'.$event->id.'.pdf')->andReturn(response('PDF'));
        \PDF::shouldReceive('loadView')->once()->withArgs(function ($view, $data) use (&$html) {
            $this->assertSame('events.pdf', $view);
            $html = view($view, $data)->render();
            return true;
        })->andReturn($pdf);
        $before = $event->fresh()->getAttributes();
        app(EventRequestController::class)->generatePdf($event->id);
        $this->assertSame($before, $event->fresh()->getAttributes());
        return substr($html, strpos($html, '<!-- Approval History Table -->'));
    }

    public function test_pdf_uses_philippine_time_and_does_not_duplicate_final_approval(): void
    {
        $user = User::forceCreate(['name' => 'Final Approver', 'email' => 'final@example.com', 'role' => 'school_admin']);
        $event = $this->event(['user_id' => $user->id, 'status' => 'Approved',
            'approved_by' => $user->id, 'approved_at' => '2026-10-24 00:43:00',
            'approval_history' => [
                ['level' => 1, 'role' => 'Program Head', 'approver_id' => $user->id, 'approver' => $user->name, 'at' => '2026-10-24 00:41:00'],
                ['level' => 2, 'role' => 'Academic Head', 'approver_id' => $user->id, 'approver' => $user->name, 'at' => '2026-10-24T08:42:00+08:00'],
                ['level' => 4, 'role' => 'School Admin', 'approver_id' => $user->id, 'approver' => $user->name, 'at' => '2026-10-24 00:43:00'],
            ]]);
        $event->created_at = '2026-10-23 16:37:00';
        $html = $this->renderPdf($event);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Date/Time (PHT, UTC+08:00)', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('10/24/2026 12:37 AM', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('10/24/2026 08:41 AM', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('10/24/2026 08:42 AM', $html);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '10/24/2026 08:43 AM'));
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '<td>School Admin</td>'));
    }

    public function test_pdf_converts_legacy_approval_columns_and_keeps_final_approver_fallback(): void
    {
        $users = collect(['Program', 'Academic', 'Building', 'School'])->map(fn ($name) => User::forceCreate([
            'name' => $name, 'email' => strtolower($name).'@example.com', 'role' => 'school_admin',
        ]));
        $event = $this->event(['user_id' => $users[0]->id, 'status' => 'Approved', 'approval_route' => null,
            'approval_history' => [], 'approved_by' => $users[3]->id, 'approved_at' => '2026-10-24 16:43:00',
            'approved_by_level_1' => $users[0]->id, 'approved_at_level_1' => '2026-10-24 16:41:00',
            'approved_by_level_2' => $users[1]->id, 'approved_at_level_2' => '2026-10-24 16:42:00',
            'approved_by_level_3' => $users[2]->id, 'approved_at_level_3' => '2026-10-24 16:42:30']);
        $html = $this->renderPdf($event);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('10/25/2026 12:41 AM', $html);
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, '10/25/2026 12:42 AM'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('10/25/2026 12:43 AM', $html);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($html, '<td>School Admin</td>'));
    }

    public function test_pdf_header_text_and_footer_copy_fit_inside_their_dividers_on_every_page(): void
    {
        if (! extension_loaded('gd')) $this->markTestSkipped('GD is required to render the PDF logos.');
        foreach ([false, true] as $long) {
            $event = $this->event(['status' => 'Approved', 'event_date' => '2026-10-31']);
            $event->created_at = now();
            $event->start_time = '08:30'; $event->end_time = '10:30';
            $event->description = $long ? str_repeat("Room use: Workshop and presentations.\n", 90) : 'Workshop';
            $pdf = app('dompdf.wrapper')->loadView('events.pdf', [
                'eventRequest' => $event, 'requester' => (object) ['name' => 'Requester'],
                'approvers' => [], 'finalApprover' => null,
            ])->setPaper('a4', 'portrait');
            $pages = [];
            $pdf->getDomPDF()->setCallbacks([['event' => 'end_frame', 'f' => function ($frame, $canvas) use (&$pages) {
                $node = $frame->get_node();
                if (! $node instanceof \DOMElement) return;
                $class = $node->getAttribute('class');
                if (in_array($class, ['letterhead', 'report-title', 'address', 'pdf-footer', 'footer-copy'], true)) {
                    $pages[$canvas->get_page_number()][$class] = $frame->get_border_box();
                }
            }]]);
            $pdf->render();
            $count = $pdf->getDomPDF()->getCanvas()->get_page_count();
            $this->assertCount($count, $pages);
            $long ? $this->assertGreaterThan(1, $count) : $this->assertSame(1, $count);
            foreach ($pages as $boxes) {
                $header = $boxes['letterhead']; $footer = $boxes['pdf-footer'];
                foreach (['report-title', 'address'] as $class) {
                    $text = $boxes[$class];
                    $this->assertGreaterThan(250, $text['w'], 'The header text column must not collapse.');
                    $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual($header['x'], $text['x']);
                    $this->assertLessThanOrEqual($header['x'] + $header['w'], $text['x'] + $text['w']);
                    $this->assertLessThan($header['y'] + $header['h'] - 4, $text['y'] + $text['h'], 'Header text crossed the divider.');
                }
                $copy = $boxes['footer-copy'];
                $this->assertLessThanOrEqual($footer['x'] + $footer['w'], $copy['x'] + $copy['w']);
                $this->assertLessThanOrEqual($footer['y'] + $footer['h'], $copy['y'] + $copy['h']);
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_saved_four_step_route_is_used_even_for_non_academic_requests_without_approver_accounts(): void

        $event = $this->event();
        $progress = app(FacilityApprovalProgress::class)->forRequest($event);

/* FILE: tests/Feature/FacilityNotificationWordingTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\EventRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\EventRequestApprovalNotification;
use App\Notifications\NewEventRequestNotification;
use Tests\TestCase;

class FacilityNotificationWordingTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_each_approval_email_and_notification_uses_facility_wording_without_congratulations(): void
    {
        $user = new User(['name' => 'Franck Mercurio', 'email' => 'franck@example.com']);
        foreach ([['Expired', 1, false], ['Rejected', 2, false], ['Approved', 1, false], ['Approved', 4, true]] as [$status, $level, $complete]) {
            $notification = new EventRequestApprovalNotification('Conference Room - Oct 24, 2026', $level, $status,
                'Building Admin', 'School Administrator', 4, $complete);
            $mail = $notification->toMail($user);
            $text = implode(' ', [$mail->subject, $mail->greeting, ...$mail->introLines, ...$mail->outroLines]);
            $this->assertStringStartsWith('Facility Request', $mail->subject);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('facility request', $text);
            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/\bevents?\b|Congratulations/i', $text);
            $this->assertSame('Hello Franck Mercurio!', $mail->greeting);
            $data = $notification->toArray($user);
            $this->assertStringStartsWith('Facility Request', $data['title']);
            $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/\bevents?\b/i', $data['message']);
            $this->assertSame('Conference Room - Oct 24, 2026', $data['event_title']);
            $this->assertStringContainsString($status === 'Expired' ? '/my-events' : '/events/my', $mail->actionUrl);
        }
    }

    public function test_approver_email_and_notification_use_facility_request_wording(): void
    {
        $requester = new User(['name' => 'Requester']);
        $request = new EventRequest(['location' => 'Conference Room', 'event_date' => '2026-10-24',
            'start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '12:00', 'description' => 'Research workshop']);
        $request->setRelation('user', $requester);
        $notification = new NewEventRequestNotification($request);
        $recipient = new User(['name' => 'School Administrator']);
        $mail = $notification->toMail($recipient);
        $text = implode(' ', [$mail->subject, $mail->actionText, ...$mail->introLines, ...$mail->outroLines]);
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('New Facility Request', $mail->subject);
        $this->assertSame('Review Facility Request', $mail->actionText);
        $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/\bevents?\b/i', $text);
        $data = $notification->toArray($recipient);
        $this->assertSame('New Facility Request Pending', $data['title']);
        $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression('/\bevents?\b/i', $data['message']);
        $this->assertSame('/admin/events', $data['url']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class HistoryAccessTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_only_system_administrator_can_open_forensic_audit_logs(): void
    {
        $mis = User::create([
            'name' => 'MIS User',
            'email' => 'mis@example.com',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
            'role' => 'mis',
        ]);
        $buildingAdmin = User::create([
            'name' => 'Building Admin',
            'email' => 'building@example.com',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
            'role' => 'building_admin',
        ]);

        $administrator = User::forceCreate([
            'name' => 'Administrator', 'email' => 'administrator@example.com',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'), 'role' => 'superadmin', 'is_superadmin' => true,
        ]);
        $this->actingAs($administrator)->get(route('admin.logs'))->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($mis)->get(route('admin.logs'))->assertNotFound();
        $this->actingAs($buildingAdmin)->get(route('admin.logs'))->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_personal_history_only_contains_the_current_users_actions(): void
    {
        $user = User::create([
            'name' => 'Faculty User',
            'email' => 'faculty@example.com',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
            'role' => 'faculty',
        ]);
        $other = User::create([
            'name' => 'Other User',
            'email' => 'other@example.com',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
            'role' => 'student',
        ]);

        ActivityLog::create([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'action' => 'password_changed',
            'description' => 'Visible personal action',
        ]);
        ActivityLog::create([
            'user_id' => $other->id,
            'action' => 'password_changed',
            'description' => 'Hidden action from another account',
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($user)
            ->get(route('history.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('Visible personal action')
            ->assertDontSee('Hidden action from another account');
    }

    public function test_mis_can_use_the_personal_history_page(): void
    {
        $mis = User::create([
            'name' => 'MIS User',
            'email' => 'mis-history@example.com',
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
            'role' => 'mis',
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($mis)->get(route('history.index'))->assertOk();
    }
}
