<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\ManagementController;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ManagementCategoryScopeTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Schema::dropIfExists('facilities');
        Schema::dropIfExists('maintenance_staff');
        Schema::dropIfExists('event_departments');
        Schema::dropIfExists('categories');

        Schema::create('categories', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name')->unique();
            $table->json('issues')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });

        Schema::create('maintenance_staff', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->boolean('is_active')->default(true);
            $table->softDeletes();
            $table->timestamps();
        });

        Schema::create('facilities', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('type')->nullable();
            $table->string('location')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedInteger('capacity')->nullable();
            $table->text('description')->nullable();
            $table->string('status')->default('available');
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('managed_by')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });

        Schema::create('event_departments', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name')->unique();
            $table->boolean('is_active')->default(true);
            $table->timestamps();
        });

        Category::create(['name' => 'Maintenance']);
        Category::create(['name' => 'Cleaning']);
        Category::create(['name' => 'Technology/Internet']);
        Category::create(['name' => 'Unassigned Category']);
    }

    public function test_mis_management_hides_staff_and_shows_only_technology_internet(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->roleUser('mis'));

        $view = app(ManagementController::class)->index(Request::create('/mis/management', 'GET', ['tab' => 'staff']));

        $this->assertSame('categories', $view->getData()['tab']);
        $this->assertTrue($view->getData()['isMisManagement']);
        $this->assertSame(['Technology/Internet'], $view->getData()['categories']->pluck('name')->all());

        $facilitiesView = app(ManagementController::class)->index(Request::create('/mis/management', 'GET', ['tab' => 'facilities']));
        $eventsView = app(ManagementController::class)->index(Request::create('/mis/management', 'GET', ['tab' => 'events']));

        $this->assertSame('facilities', $facilitiesView->getData()['tab']);
        $this->assertSame('events', $eventsView->getData()['tab']);
    }

    public function test_building_administrator_management_keeps_only_cleaning_and_maintenance_categories(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->roleUser('building_admin'));

        $view = app(ManagementController::class)->index(Request::create('/building-admin/management', 'GET', ['tab' => 'categories']));

        $this->assertFalse($view->getData()['isMisManagement']);
        $this->assertSame(['Cleaning', 'Maintenance'], $view->getData()['categories']->pluck('name')->all());
    }

    public function test_mis_cannot_modify_a_building_administrator_category_with_a_crafted_request(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->roleUser('mis'));
        $maintenance = Category::where('name', 'Maintenance')->firstOrFail();

        $this->expectException(HttpException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('You cannot manage this category.');

        app(ManagementController::class)->updateCategory(
            Request::create('/admin/management/categories/'.$maintenance->id, 'PUT', [
                'name' => 'Maintenance',
                'issues' => [],
            ]),
            $maintenance->id
        );
    }

    public function test_mis_can_manage_facilities_and_event_setup(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->roleUser('mis'));
        $facility = \App\Models\Facility::create([
            'name' => 'Computer Laboratory',
            'type' => 'lab',
            'status' => 'available',
        ]);

        $statusResponse = app(ManagementController::class)->updateFacilityStatus(
            Request::create('/admin/management/facilities/'.$facility->id.'/status', 'PATCH', ['status' => 'under_maintenance']),
            $facility->id
        );
        $this->assertSame('under_maintenance', $statusResponse->getData(true)['status']);
        $this->assertSame('under_maintenance', $facility->fresh()->status);

        app(ManagementController::class)->storeEventDepartment(
            Request::create('/admin/management/event-setup/departments', 'POST', ['name' => 'Information Technology'])
        );
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('event_departments', ['name' => 'Information Technology', 'is_active' => true]);
    }

    private function roleUser(string $role): User
    {
        $user = new User;
        $user->forceFill([
            'id' => $role === 'mis' ? 101 : 102,
            'name' => str($role)->replace('_', ' ')->title()->toString(),
            'email' => $role.'@example.com',
            'role' => $role,
            'is_superadmin' => false,
        ]);

        return $user;
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/MultipleRoomFacilityRequestTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\EventRequestController;
use App\Models\EventRequest;
use App\Models\EventRequestType;
use App\Models\EventIntendedUser;
use App\Models\Facility;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\UserRateLimit;
use App\Services\FacilityRoomSelection;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class MultipleRoomFacilityRequestTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Schema::dropAllTables();
        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->uuid('uuid'); $table->string('name'); $table->string('email');
            $table->string('role'); $table->string('department')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false); $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false); $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('facilities', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->string('name'); $table->string('type'); $table->string('status')->default('available'); $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('event_requests', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id'); $table->date('event_date');
            foreach (['location', 'start_time', 'end_time', 'category', 'request_type', 'other_category', 'department', 'education_level', 'intended_user', 'priority', 'status', 'image_path', 'notes'] as $column) $table->string($column)->nullable();
            $table->text('description')->nullable();
            foreach (['approval_route', 'approval_history', 'materials_needed'] as $column) $table->json($column)->nullable();
            $table->unsignedInteger('approval_level')->default(1);
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('approved_by')->nullable(); $table->timestamp('approved_at')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false); $table->timestamps();
        });
        $migration = require database_path('migrations/2026_10_24_000001_add_requested_rooms_to_event_requests.php');
        $migration->up();
        Schema::create('event_request_types', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->string('name'); $table->json('approval_roles'); $table->boolean('is_active')->default(true); $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('event_intended_users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->string('name'); $table->string('code'); $table->json('approval_roles'); $table->boolean('is_active')->default(true); $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('user_rate_limits', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id'); $table->string('action_type'); $table->date('date'); $table->unsignedInteger('count'); $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('activity_logs', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id(); $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id')->nullable(); $table->unsignedBigInteger('concern_id')->nullable();
            foreach (['action', 'description', 'ip_address', 'user_agent', 'old_values', 'new_values', 'metadata'] as $column) $table->text($column)->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Facility::create(['name' => 'Room 301', 'type' => 'room']);
        Facility::create(['name' => 'Room 302', 'type' => 'room']);
        EventRequestType::create(['name' => 'Academic', 'approval_roles' => ['building_admin', 'school_admin']]);
        EventIntendedUser::create(['name' => 'Faculty', 'code' => 'faculty', 'approval_roles' => ['building_admin', 'school_admin']]);
        $this->actingAs(User::forceCreate(['name' => 'Requester', 'email' => 'faculty@example.com', 'role' => 'faculty']));
    }

    private function rooms(): array
    {
        return [['location' => 'Room 301', 'reason' => 'Presentations'], ['location' => 'Room 302', 'reason' => 'Breakout groups']];
    }

    private function submit(array $overrides = [])
    {
        $payload = array_merge([
            'rooms' => $this->rooms(), 'description' => 'Research workshop',
            'event_date' => now()->addDays(2)->toDateString(), 'start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '12:00',
            'category' => 'Area Use', 'request_type' => 'Academic', 'intended_user' => 'faculty',
        ], $overrides);
        if ($payload['rooms'] === null) unset($payload['rooms']);
        $request = Request::create('/events', 'POST', $payload);
        $request->headers->set('Accept', 'application/json');
        return app(EventRequestController::class)->store($request);
    }

    private function availability(string $room, string $start = '10:00', string $end = '12:00'): array
    {
        return app(EventRequestController::class)->checkRoomAvailability(Request::create('/api/check-room-availability', 'GET', [
            'location' => $room, 'event_date' => now()->addDays(2)->toDateString(), 'start_time' => $start, 'end_time' => $end,
        ]))->getData(true);
    }

    public function test_two_rooms_create_one_request_and_one_submission_count_with_both_reasons_and_one_route(): void
    {
        $response = $this->submit();
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode(), $response->getContent());
        $this->assertSame(1, EventRequest::count());
        $event = EventRequest::first();
        $this->assertSame($this->rooms(), $event->requested_rooms);
        $this->assertSame('Room 301, Room 302', $event->location);
        $this->assertSame(['building_admin', 'school_admin'], $event->approval_route);
        $this->assertSame('Pending', $event->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Room 301: Presentations', $event->description);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Room 302: Breakout groups', $event->description);
        $this->assertSame(1, (int) UserRateLimit::first()->count);
    }

    public function test_missing_room_reason_duplicate_room_and_unknown_room_are_rejected_without_creating_requests(): void
    {
        foreach ([
            [['location' => 'Room 301'], ['location' => 'Room 302', 'reason' => '   ']],
            [['location' => 'Room 301', 'reason' => 'First'], ['location' => 'Room 301', 'reason' => 'Second']],
            [['location' => 'Unknown room', 'reason' => 'Workshop']],
        ] as $rooms) {
            $this->assertSame(422, $this->submit(['rooms' => $rooms])->getStatusCode());
        }
        $this->assertSame(0, EventRequest::count());
    }

    public function test_approved_multi_room_request_reserves_every_room_but_not_adjacent_time_slots(): void
    {
        $this->submit();
        EventRequest::first()->update(['status' => 'Approved']);
        $this->assertFalse($this->availability('Room 301')['available']);
        $this->assertFalse($this->availability('Room 302')['available']);
        $this->assertTrue($this->availability('Room 302', '12:00', '13:00')['available']);
    }

    public function test_one_conflicting_room_rejects_the_entire_submission(): void
    {
        EventRequest::create(['user_id' => auth()->id(), 'location' => 'Room 302', 'status' => 'Approved',
            'event_date' => now()->addDays(2)->toDateString(), 'start_time' => '11:00', 'end_time' => '13:00']);
        $response = $this->submit();
        $this->assertSame(422, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Room 302', $response->getContent());
        $this->assertSame(1, EventRequest::count());
    }

    public function test_unavailable_additional_room_is_rejected_and_pending_requests_do_not_reserve_rooms(): void
    {
        $this->submit();
        $this->assertTrue($this->availability('Room 302')['available']);
        Facility::where('name', 'Room 302')->update(['status' => 'unavailable']);
        $this->assertSame(422, $this->submit()->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(1, EventRequest::count());
    }

    public function test_rescheduling_checks_additional_rooms_and_does_not_change_a_request_on_conflict(): void
    {
        $this->submit();
        $event = EventRequest::first();
        EventRequest::create(['user_id' => auth()->id(), 'location' => 'Room 302', 'status' => 'Approved',
            'event_date' => now()->addDays(3)->toDateString(), 'start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '12:00']);
        $before = $event->fresh()->getAttributes();
        try {
            app(EventRequestController::class)->reschedule(Request::create('/events/'.$event->id.'/reschedule', 'POST', [
                'event_date' => now()->addDays(3)->toDateString(), 'start_time' => '10:00', 'end_time' => '12:00',
            ]), $event->id);
            $this->fail('Expected room conflict validation.');
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Room 302', $exception->getMessage());
        }
        $this->assertSame($before, $event->fresh()->getAttributes());
    }

    public function test_legacy_single_room_requests_still_submit_without_rooms_array(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(200, $this->submit(['rooms' => null, 'location' => 'Room 301', 'area_of_use' => 'Room 301'])->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(['Room 301'], EventRequest::first()->roomLocations());
    }

    public function test_first_room_uses_description_without_a_separate_reason(): void
    {
        $response = $this->submit(['rooms' => [['location' => 'Room 301']]]);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode(), $response->getContent());
        $this->assertSame('Research workshop', EventRequest::first()->description);
    }

    public function test_only_additional_rooms_require_and_display_a_reason(): void
    {
        $response = $this->submit(['rooms' => [['location' => 'Room 301'], $this->rooms()[1]]]);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode(), $response->getContent());
        $event = EventRequest::first();
        $this->assertSame(['Room 301', 'Room 302'], $event->roomLocations());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Room 302: Breakout groups', $event->description);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Room 301:', $event->description);
    }

    public function test_long_location_summary_fits_legacy_column_without_losing_selected_rooms(): void
    {
        $rooms = array_fill(0, 10, ['location' => str_repeat('Room ', 30), 'reason' => 'Workshop']);
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(255, mb_strlen(app(FacilityRoomSelection::class)->locationSummary($rooms)));
    }

    public function test_unmigrated_database_keeps_single_room_submission_and_availability_working(): void
    {
        Schema::table('event_requests', fn (Blueprint $table) => $table->dropColumn('requested_rooms'));
        $this->assertSame(200, $this->submit(['rooms' => [$this->rooms()[0]]])->getStatusCode());
        EventRequest::first()->update(['status' => 'Approved']);
        $this->assertFalse($this->availability('Room 301')['available']);
        $this->assertSame(422, $this->submit()->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame(1, EventRequest::count());
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/NewConcernReviewerNotificationTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Concern;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\NewConcernSubmittedNotification;
use App\Services\NotificationService;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class NewConcernReviewerNotificationTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Schema::dropIfExists('concerns');
        Schema::dropIfExists('categories');
        Schema::dropIfExists('users');

        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->uuid('uuid')->unique();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('email')->unique();
            $table->string('password');
            $table->string('role');
            $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false);
            $table->timestamps();
        });

        Schema::create('categories', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->json('issues')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });

        Schema::create('concerns', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('title');
            $table->text('description')->nullable();
            $table->string('location');
            $table->foreignId('category_id');
            $table->foreignId('user_id');
            $table->string('status')->default('Pending');
            $table->boolean('is_anonymous')->default(false);
            $table->timestamps();
        });
    }

    public function test_technology_concerns_notify_active_mis_users_instead_of_building_admins(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();

        $reporter = $this->createUser('reporter@example.com', 'student');
        $mis = $this->createUser('mis@example.com', 'mis');
        $archivedMis = $this->createUser('archived-mis@example.com', 'mis', true);
        $buildingAdmin = $this->createUser('building@example.com', 'building_admin');
        $category = Category::create(['name' => 'Technology/Internet']);
        $concern = $this->createConcern($reporter, $category);

        (new NotificationService)->notifyReviewersOfNewConcern($concern);

        Notification::assertSentTo($mis, NewConcernSubmittedNotification::class);
        Notification::assertNotSentTo($archivedMis, NewConcernSubmittedNotification::class);
        Notification::assertNotSentTo($buildingAdmin, NewConcernSubmittedNotification::class);
    }

    public function test_other_concerns_continue_to_notify_building_admins(): void
    {
        Notification::fake();

        $reporter = $this->createUser('reporter-other@example.com', 'faculty');
        $mis = $this->createUser('mis-other@example.com', 'mis');
        $buildingAdmin = $this->createUser('building-other@example.com', 'building_admin');
        $category = Category::create(['name' => 'Maintenance']);
        $concern = $this->createConcern($reporter, $category);

        (new NotificationService)->notifyReviewersOfNewConcern($concern);

        Notification::assertSentTo($buildingAdmin, NewConcernSubmittedNotification::class);
        Notification::assertNotSentTo($mis, NewConcernSubmittedNotification::class);
    }

    private function createUser(string $email, string $role, bool $archived = false): User
    {
        return User::create([
            'name' => $email,
            'email' => $email,
            'password' => bcrypt('password'),
            'role' => $role,
            'is_archived' => $archived,
        ]);
    }

    private function createConcern(User $reporter, Category $category): Concern
    {
        return Concern::create([
            'title' => 'Network connection issue',
            'description' => 'No internet connection',
            'location' => 'Room 301',
            'category_id' => $category->id,
            'user_id' => $reporter->id,
            'status' => 'Pending',
            'is_anonymous' => false,
        ]);
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/OpaquePageUrlTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Middleware\UseOpaquePageUrls;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Support\OpaquePageUrl;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Tests\TestCase;

class OpaquePageUrlTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        config([
            'app.key' => 'base64:'.base64_encode(str_repeat('o', 32)),
            'app.cipher' => 'AES-256-CBC',
        ]);
        app()->forgetInstance('encrypter');
    }

    public function test_an_authenticated_html_page_is_redirected_to_an_opaque_path(): void
    {
        config(['app.url' => 'https://different-host.example']);

        $request = Request::create('/building-admin/analytics?period=month', 'GET');
        $request->headers->set('Accept', 'text/html');
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => new User);

        $response = app(UseOpaquePageUrls::class)->handle(
            $request,
            fn () => response('original page')
        );

        $this->assertTrue($response->isRedirect());
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression(
            '#^/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{80,}$#',
            $response->headers->get('Location')
        );

        $path = parse_url($response->headers->get('Location'), PHP_URL_PATH);
        $this->assertIsString($path);
        $this->assertSame(1, substr_count(trim($path, '/'), '/') + 1);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('/hash/', $path);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('building-admin', $path);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('analytics', $path);

        $token = ltrim($path, '/');
        $this->assertSame(
            '/building-admin/analytics?period=month',
            app(OpaquePageUrl::class)->decode($token)
        );
    }

    public function test_opaque_tokens_reject_modification(): void
    {
        $opaque = app(OpaquePageUrl::class);
        $token = $opaque->encode('/system-admin/users');
        $position = intdiv(strlen($token), 2);
        $character = $token[$position];
        $replacement = $character === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
        $modifiedToken = substr_replace($token, $replacement, $position, 1);

        $this->assertNull($opaque->decode($modifiedToken));
    }

    public function test_non_page_requests_are_not_redirected(): void
    {
        $middleware = app(UseOpaquePageUrls::class);

        foreach ([
            Request::create('/api/room-availability', 'GET', [], [], [], ['HTTP_ACCEPT' => 'application/json']),
            Request::create('/events', 'POST'),
            Request::create('/notifications/unread-count', 'GET', [], [], [], [
                'HTTP_ACCEPT' => 'application/json',
                'HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH' => 'XMLHttpRequest',
            ]),
        ] as $request) {
            $request->setUserResolver(fn () => new User);
            $response = $middleware->handle($request, fn () => response('unchanged'));

            $this->assertFalse($response->isRedirect());
            $this->assertSame('unchanged', $response->getContent());
        }
    }

    public function test_guests_keep_the_existing_public_path(): void
    {
        $request = Request::create('/my-events', 'GET');
        $request->headers->set('Accept', 'text/html');
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => null);

        $response = app(UseOpaquePageUrls::class)->handle(
            $request,
            fn () => response('guest response')
        );

        $this->assertFalse($response->isRedirect());
    }

    public function test_first_login_password_page_uses_an_opaque_path(): void
    {
        $request = Request::create('/first-login-password', 'GET');
        $request->headers->set('Accept', 'text/html');
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => new User);

        $response = app(UseOpaquePageUrls::class)->handle(
            $request,
            fn () => response('first login password page')
        );

        $this->assertTrue($response->isRedirect());
        $token = ltrim((string) parse_url($response->headers->get('Location'), PHP_URL_PATH), '/');
        $this->assertSame('/first-login-password', app(OpaquePageUrl::class)->decode($token));
    }

    public function test_forced_password_user_can_open_only_the_opaque_password_setup_page(): void
    {
        $user = new User;
        $user->forceFill([
            'id' => 987655,
            'role' => 'student',
            'force_password_change' => true,
            'active_session_id' => null,
        ]);
        $this->actingAs($user);

        $redirect = $this->get('/first-login-password');
        $redirect->assertRedirect();
        $location = $redirect->headers->get('Location');
        $this->assertSame('/first-login-password', app(OpaquePageUrl::class)->decode(ltrim((string) parse_url($location, PHP_URL_PATH), '/')));

        $this->get($location)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSeeText('Please set your new password and mobile number');
    }

    public function test_an_opaque_url_dispatches_the_original_route_with_its_middleware(): void
    {
        Route::middleware(['web', 'auth', 'superadmin'])
            ->get('/opaque-test-page', function () {
                abort_unless(auth()->check(), 418);

                return response('protected page');
            })
            ->name('test.opaque-page');

        $user = new User;
        $user->forceFill([
            'id' => 987654,
            'role' => 'admin',
            'active_session_id' => null,
            'force_password_change' => false,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($user);
        $redirect = $this->get('/opaque-test-page');
        $redirect->assertRedirect();

        $location = $redirect->headers->get('Location');
        $this->assertIsString($location);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('#^/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{80,}$#', $location);

        $this->get($location)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSeeText('protected page');
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/OtpSmsDeliveryTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Client\ConnectionException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class OtpSmsDeliveryTest extends TestCase
{
    private User $user;

    public function test_timer_keeps_the_saved_expiry_after_refresh_and_a_failed_attempt(): void
    {
        $this->travelTo(now()->startOfSecond());
        $this->user->update([
            'otp' => Hash::make('123456'),
            'otp_expires_at' => now()->utc()->addMinutes(5),
        ]);
        $this->withSession(['otp_user' => $this->user->id, 'reset_timer' => true])
            ->get('/verify-otp')->assertOk()->assertViewHas('otpRemainingMilliseconds', 300000);

        $this->travel(1)->minutes();
        $this->get('/verify-otp')->assertOk()->assertViewHas('otpRemainingMilliseconds', 240000);
        $this->from('/verify-otp')->post('/verify-otp', ['otp' => '000000'])
            ->assertRedirect('/verify-otp')->assertSessionHas('error', 'Invalid OTP code');
        $this->get('/verify-otp')->assertOk()->assertViewHas('otpRemainingMilliseconds', 240000);

        $this->travel(5)->minutes();
        $this->get('/verify-otp')->assertOk()->assertViewHas('otpRemainingMilliseconds', 0);

        $this->user->update(['otp_expires_at' => now()->utc()->addMinutes(5)]);
        $this->get('/verify-otp')->assertOk()->assertViewHas('otpRemainingMilliseconds', 300000);
    }

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Schema::dropIfExists('users');
        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->uuid('uuid');
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('email');
            $table->string('password');
            $table->string('role');
            $table->string('phone')->nullable();
            $table->string('otp')->nullable();
            $table->timestamp('otp_expires_at')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedInteger('otp_attempts')->default(0);
            $table->string('active_session_id')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false);
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        $this->user = User::create([
            'name' => 'SMS User', 'email' => 'sms@novaliches.sti.edu.ph',
            'password' => 'password', 'role' => 'student', 'phone' => '09171234567',
        ]);
        config(['services.sms' => [
            'api_key' => 'test-secret', 'api_url' => 'https://unismsapi.com/api/sms', 'sender_name' => 'Unisoft',
        ]]);
        Http::preventStrayRequests();
    }

    public function test_a_timed_out_send_keeps_the_otp_valid_and_still_requires_verification(): void
    {
        $code = null;
        $attempts = 0;
        Http::fake(function ($request) use (&$code, &$attempts) {
            $attempts++;
            preg_match('/code is: (\d{6})/', $request['content'], $matches);
            $code = $matches[1];
            throw new ConnectionException('cURL error 28: response timed out after the request was sent');
        });
        $this->withSession(['otp_user' => $this->user->id])->post('/otp-delivery', ['delivery_method' => 'phone'])
            ->assertRedirect('/verify-otp')->assertSessionHas('warning')
            ->assertSessionMissing('error')->assertSessionHas('otp_delivery_pending', true);
        $this->assertSame(1, $attempts);
        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->assertTrue(Hash::check($code, $this->user->fresh()->otp));
        $this->assertNotSame($code, $this->user->fresh()->otp);
        $this->get('/verify-otp')->assertOk()->assertSee('SMS confirmation is delayed.')
            ->assertSee('Try another way')->assertSee('If your code arrives');
        $this->post('/verify-otp', ['otp' => $code])->assertRedirect('/dashboard');
        $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($this->user);
        $this->assertNull($this->user->fresh()->otp);
    }

    public function test_a_provider_rejection_does_not_save_an_undelivered_challenge(): void
    {
        $oldHash = Hash::make('654321');
        $this->user->update(['otp' => $oldHash, 'otp_expires_at' => now()->addMinutes(5)]);
        Http::fake(['*' => Http::response(['errors' => ['sender_id' => ['Invalid sender']]], 422)]);
        $this->withSession(['otp_user' => $this->user->id])->from('/otp-choice')
            ->post('/otp-delivery', ['delivery_method' => 'phone'])->assertRedirect('/otp-choice')
            ->assertSessionHas('error', fn ($value) => str_contains($value, 'SMS-SENDER'))
            ->assertSessionMissing('otp_delivery_pending');
        $this->assertSame($oldHash, $this->user->fresh()->otp);
        $this->assertGuest();
        Http::assertSentCount(1);
    }

    public function test_dns_failure_stays_on_delivery_choice_instead_of_claiming_possible_delivery(): void
    {
        Http::fake(fn () => throw new ConnectionException('cURL error 6: could not resolve host'));
        $this->withSession(['otp_user' => $this->user->id])->from('/otp-choice')
            ->post('/otp-delivery', ['delivery_method' => 'phone'])->assertRedirect('/otp-choice')
            ->assertSessionHas('error', fn ($value) => str_contains($value, 'SMS-DNS'));
        $this->assertNull($this->user->fresh()->otp);
        $this->assertGuest();
    }

    public function test_a_confirmed_send_uses_the_normal_verification_flow(): void
    {
        Http::fake(['*' => Http::response(['message' => ['status' => 'pending']], 201)]);
        $this->withSession(['otp_user' => $this->user->id])->post('/otp-delivery', ['delivery_method' => 'phone'])
            ->assertRedirect('/verify-otp')->assertSessionHas('success')
            ->assertSessionHas('otp_delivery_pending', false)->assertSessionMissing('warning');
        $this->assertNotNull($this->user->fresh()->otp);
        $this->assertGuest();
    }

    public function test_a_pending_delivery_does_not_extend_expiration_or_accept_a_wrong_code(): void
    {
        Http::fake(fn () => throw new ConnectionException('cURL error 28: response timed out'));
        $this->withSession(['otp_user' => $this->user->id])->post('/otp-delivery', ['delivery_method' => 'phone'])
            ->assertRedirect('/verify-otp');
        $this->post('/verify-otp', ['otp' => '000000'])->assertSessionHas('error', 'Invalid OTP code');
        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->travel(6)->minutes();
        $this->post('/verify-otp', ['otp' => '000000'])->assertSessionHas('error', 'OTP has expired. Please request a new code.');
        $this->assertGuest();
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/ReopenTicketTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\RoleAnalyticsController;
use App\Models\ActivityLog;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Concern;
use App\Models\Report;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Notifications\TicketReopenedNotification;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ReopenTicketTest extends TestCase
{
    private User $reporter;

    private User $mis;

    private Concern $concern;

    private Report $report;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        // Match other workflow tests: isolate this feature from legacy migration ordering.
        foreach (['users', 'categories', 'concerns', 'reports', 'activity_logs', 'concern_reporters', 'user_archived_reports', 'user_archived_concerns', 'maintenance_staff'] as $table) {
            Schema::dropIfExists($table);

            $table->uuid('uuid');
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('email');

            $table->string('role');
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false);
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('categories', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('maintenance_staff', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('email')->nullable();
            $table->softDeletes();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        foreach (['concerns', 'reports'] as $name) {
            Schema::create($name, function (Blueprint $table) use ($name) {
                $table->id();
                $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id');
                $table->unsignedBigInteger('category_id');
                if ($name === 'reports') {
                    $table->unsignedBigInteger('concern_id')->nullable();
                }
                $table->string('title');
                $table->text('description')->nullable();
                $table->text('details')->nullable();
                $table->string('reporter_name')->nullable();
                $table->boolean('is_anonymous')->default(false);
                $table->unsignedInteger('report_count')->default(1);
                $table->string('image_path')->nullable();
                $table->string('photo_path')->nullable();
                $table->decimal('budget_amount')->nullable();
                $table->string('budget_status')->nullable();
                $table->unsignedBigInteger('budget_requested_by')->nullable();
                $table->unsignedBigInteger('budget_reviewed_by')->nullable();
                $table->timestamp('budget_requested_at')->nullable();
                $table->timestamp('budget_reviewed_at')->nullable();
                $table->text('budget_rejection_reason')->nullable();
                $table->string('location')->nullable();
                $table->string('priority')->nullable();
                $table->string('status');
                $table->unsignedBigInteger('assigned_to')->nullable();
                $table->timestamp('assigned_at')->nullable();
                $table->timestamp('in_progress_at')->nullable();
                $table->timestamp('resolved_at')->nullable();
                $table->text('resolution_notes')->nullable();
                $table->decimal('cost')->nullable();
                $table->string('damaged_part')->nullable();
                $table->string('replaced_part')->nullable();
                $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false);
                $table->timestamp('deleted_at')->nullable();
                $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false);
                $table->boolean('mis_archived')->default(false);
                $table->timestamp('archived_at')->nullable();
                $table->timestamp('auto_delete_at')->nullable();
                $table->boolean('follow_up_sent')->default(false);
                $table->timestamp('follow_up_sent_at')->nullable();
                $table->timestamps();
            });
            Schema::create('user_archived_'.$name, function (Blueprint $table) use ($name) {
                $table->unsignedBigInteger($name === 'reports' ? 'report_id' : 'concern_id');
                $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id');
                $table->timestamps();
            });
        }
        Schema::create('concern_reporters', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('concern_id');
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id');
            $table->boolean('is_original')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_anonymous')->default(false);
            $table->timestamp('reported_at')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('activity_logs', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('concern_id')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('report_id')->nullable();
            $table->string('action');
            $table->text('description');
            $table->string('ip_address')->nullable();
            $table->text('user_agent')->nullable();
            $table->json('old_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('new_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('metadata')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Notification::fake();
        $this->reporter = $this->user('student');
        $this->mis = $this->user('mis');
        $category = Category::create(['name' => 'Technology/Internet']);
        $this->concern = Concern::create([
            'user_id' => $this->reporter->id, 'category_id' => $category->id,
            'title' => 'Internet unavailable', 'location' => 'Room 301', 'status' => 'Resolved',
            'assigned_to' => $this->mis->id, 'assigned_at' => now()->subDays(2),
            'resolved_at' => now()->subDay(), 'resolution_notes' => 'Replaced cable', 'cost' => 150,
        ]);
        $this->report = Report::create(array_merge($this->concern->only([
            'user_id', 'category_id', 'title', 'location', 'status', 'assigned_to', 'assigned_at', 'resolved_at', 'resolution_notes', 'cost',
        ]), ['concern_id' => $this->concern->id]));
        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) {
            $ticket->in_progress_at = now()->subDays(2);
            $ticket->save();
        }
    }

    public function test_my_concerns_view_returns_additional_description(): void
    {
        $this->reporter->update(['role' => 'faculty']);
        $details = "The outlet cover is loose.\nNear the lobby entrance.";
        $this->concern->update(['details' => $details]);

        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)
            ->getJson('/concerns/'.$this->concern->id.'/modal-data')
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('concern.details', $details);

        $this->concern->update(['details' => null]);
        $this->getJson('/concerns/'.$this->concern->id.'/modal-data')
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('concern.details', null);
    }

    public function test_my_concerns_view_uses_description_saved_on_the_linked_report(): void
    {
        $this->report->update(['details' => 'Outlet cover is loose.']);
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)
            ->getJson('/concerns/'.$this->concern->id.'/modal-data')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('concern.details', 'Outlet cover is loose.');

        $this->concern->update(['details' => 'Updated concern description.']);
        $this->getJson('/concerns/'.$this->concern->id.'/modal-data')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('concern.details', 'Updated concern description.');
    }

    public function test_duplicate_submission_preserves_additional_description_for_viewing(): void
    {
        Schema::create('user_rate_limits', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id');
            $table->string('action_type');
            $table->integer('count')->default(0);
            $table->date('date');
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        $this->concern->update(['status' => 'Pending', 'description' => 'Damaged cover', 'details' => 'Original details.']);
        $this->report->update(['details' => 'Original details.']);
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.store'), [
            'category_id' => $this->concern->category_id,
            'title' => $this->concern->title,
            'location' => $this->concern->location,
            'description' => 'Damaged cover',
            'details' => 'The cover is now detached.',
        ])->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('linked_duplicate', true);

        $expected = "Original details.\n\nThe cover is now detached.";
        $this->getJson('/concerns/'.$this->concern->id.'/modal-data')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('concern.details', $expected);
        $this->assertSame($expected, $this->report->fresh()->details);
    }

    public function test_concern_image_replacement_rejects_script_uploads_without_changing_the_record(): void
    {
        Schema::table('categories', fn (Blueprint $table) => $table->json('issues')->nullable());
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter);
        $request = Request::create('/concerns/'.$this->concern->id, 'POST', [
            'location' => $this->concern->location,
            'category_id' => $this->concern->category_id,
            'description' => 'Existing concern',
        ], [], ['image' => \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('bad.php', '<?php echo 1;')]);
        try {
            app(\App\Http\Controllers\ConcernController::class)->update($request, $this->concern->id);
            $this->fail('Script upload was accepted.');
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('image', $exception->errors());
        }
        $this->assertNull($this->concern->fresh()->image_path);
    }

    public function test_new_concern_upload_validation_is_not_converted_to_a_server_error(): void
    {
        Schema::create('user_rate_limits', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id');
            $table->string('action_type');
            $table->integer('count')->default(0);
            $table->date('date');
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter);
        $request = Request::create('/concerns', 'POST', [
            'location' => 'Room 301', 'category_id' => $this->concern->category_id,
        ], [], ['image' => \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('bad.jpg', '<?php echo 1;')]);
        $request->headers->set('Accept', 'application/json');
        try {
            app(\App\Http\Controllers\ConcernController::class)->store($request);
            $this->fail('Invalid image did not produce a validation error.');
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('image', $exception->errors());
            $this->assertSame(422, $exception->status);
        }
        $this->assertSame(1, Concern::count());
    }

    public function test_original_reporter_reopens_both_records_and_preserves_resolution_history(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'The same connection is still failing.'])
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('status', 'Assigned');
        foreach ([$this->concern->fresh(), $this->report->fresh()] as $ticket) {
            $this->assertSame('Assigned', $ticket->status);
            $this->assertNull($ticket->resolved_at);
            $this->assertNull($ticket->resolution_notes);
            $this->assertNull($ticket->in_progress_at);
            $this->assertTrue($ticket->assigned_at->isToday());
            $this->assertSame($this->mis->id, $ticket->assigned_to);
            $this->assertEquals(150, $ticket->cost);
        }
        $log = ActivityLog::where('action', 'concern_reopened')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame($this->reporter->id, $log->user_id);
        $this->assertSame('Replaced cable', $log->old_values['resolution_notes']);
        $this->assertNotNull($log->old_values['resolved_at']);
        $this->assertSame('The same connection is still failing.', $log->metadata['reason']);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('concerns', 1);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('reports', 1);
        Notification::assertSentTo([$this->mis, $this->reporter], TicketReopenedNotification::class);
    }

    public function test_report_endpoint_synchronizes_linked_concern(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('reports.reopen', $this->report), ['reason' => 'Still broken'])->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame('Assigned', $this->concern->fresh()->status);
    }

    private function recurrenceAnalytics(): array
    {
        $viewer = $this->user('admin');
        $this->actingAs($viewer);
        $request = Request::create('/admin/analytics');
        $request->setUserResolver(fn () => $viewer);
        return app(\App\Http\Controllers\AdminController::class)->analytics($request)->getData();
    }

    private function recordReplacement(?User $actor = null, ?string $operationId = null, ?Report $report = null)
    {
        return $this->actingAs($actor ?? $this->mis)->postJson(route('tickets.assetReplacement', [
            'resource' => 'reports', 'id' => ($report ?? $this->report)->id,
        ]), ['replacement_details' => 'New network device, asset tag NEW-304', 'replacement_notes' => 'Old unit replaced and installation tested.',
            'confirmed_replacement' => true, 'operation_id' => $operationId ?? (string) \Illuminate\Support\Str::uuid()]);
    }

    private function replacementResolutionPayload(): array
    {
        return ['status' => 'Resolved', 'cost' => 500, 'resolution_notes' => 'Installed and tested new unit.',
            'asset_replaced' => true, 'replacement_details' => 'New unit, asset tag NEW-304',
            'replacement_notes' => 'Complete unit replacement and installation tested.',
            'confirmed_replacement' => true, 'operation_id' => (string) \Illuminate\Support\Str::uuid()];
    }

    private function startReplacementResolution(): void
    {
        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) $ticket->update(['status' => 'In Progress', 'resolved_at' => null]);
    }

    public function test_replacement_can_be_recorded_while_resolving_and_a_retry_does_not_duplicate_it(): void
    {
        $this->startReplacementResolution();
        $payload = $this->replacementResolutionPayload();
        $response = $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.updateStatus', $this->report->id), $payload)->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame('Resolved', $this->report->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('Resolved', $this->concern->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertEquals(500, $this->report->fresh()->cost);
        $log = ActivityLog::where('action', 'asset_replaced')->sole();
        $this->assertSame($payload['replacement_details'], $log->metadata['replacement_details']);
        $this->assertSame('Resolved', $log->old_values['status']);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.updateStatus', $this->report->id), $payload)
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('replacement_id', $response->json('replacement_id'));
        $this->assertSame(1, ActivityLog::where('action', 'asset_replaced')->count());
    }

    public function test_replacement_resolution_requires_details_notes_and_confirmation_before_saving(): void
    {
        $this->startReplacementResolution();
        $payload = $this->replacementResolutionPayload();
        unset($payload['replacement_details'], $payload['replacement_notes'], $payload['confirmed_replacement']);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.updateStatus', $this->report->id), $payload)
            ->assertUnprocessable()->assertJsonValidationErrors(['replacement_details', 'replacement_notes', 'confirmed_replacement']);
        $this->assertSame('In Progress', $this->report->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, ActivityLog::where('action', 'asset_replaced')->count());
    }

    public function test_failed_replacement_authorization_rolls_back_report_and_concern_resolution(): void
    {
        $this->startReplacementResolution();
        $before = $this->report->fresh()->getAttributes();
        $this->actingAs($this->user('building_admin'))->postJson(route('reports.updateStatus', $this->report->id), $this->replacementResolutionPayload())->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertSame($before, $this->report->fresh()->getAttributes());
        $this->assertSame('In Progress', $this->concern->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, ActivityLog::where('action', 'asset_replaced')->count());
    }

    public function test_replacing_a_part_during_resolution_does_not_reset_asset_recurrence(): void
    {
        $this->startReplacementResolution();
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.updateStatus', $this->report->id), [
            'status' => 'Resolved', 'replaced_part' => 'Cable', 'resolution_notes' => 'Replaced only the damaged cable.',
        ])->assertOk();
        $this->assertSame('Resolved', $this->report->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, ActivityLog::where('action', 'asset_replaced')->count());
    }

    public function test_pending_budget_still_blocks_resolution_with_a_replacement(): void
    {
        $this->startReplacementResolution();
        $this->report->update(['budget_status' => 'pending', 'budget_amount' => 500]);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.updateStatus', $this->report->id), $this->replacementResolutionPayload())
            ->assertUnprocessable()->assertJsonPath('requires_budget_approval', true);
        $this->assertSame('In Progress', $this->report->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, ActivityLog::where('action', 'asset_replaced')->count());
    }

    public function test_budget_can_be_requested_before_starting_work_but_pending_or_approved_requests_cannot_be_overwritten(): void
    {
        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) $ticket->update(['status' => 'Assigned', 'resolved_at' => null]);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->getJson(route('admin.reports.modalData', $this->report))
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('report.can_request_budget', true);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.budget.request', $this->report), ['budget_amount' => 500])
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('budget_status', 'pending');
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->getJson(route('admin.reports.modalData', $this->report))
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('report.can_request_budget', false);
        $this->assertSame('Assigned', $this->report->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $this->concern->fresh()->budget_status);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.budget.request', $this->report), ['budget_amount' => 999])->assertUnprocessable();
        $this->assertEquals(500, $this->report->fresh()->budget_amount);
        $this->assertSame(1, ActivityLog::where('action', 'budget_approval_requested')->count());

        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) $ticket->update(['budget_status' => 'approved']);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.budget.request', $this->report), ['budget_amount' => 999])->assertUnprocessable();
        $this->assertSame('approved', $this->report->fresh()->budget_status);

        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) $ticket->update(['budget_status' => 'rejected']);
        $this->actingAs($this->mis)->postJson(route('reports.budget.request', $this->report), ['budget_amount' => 400])
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('budget_status', 'pending');
        $this->assertEquals(400, $this->report->fresh()->budget_amount);
        $this->assertEquals(400, $this->concern->fresh()->budget_amount);
    }

    private function reopenAndComplete(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'Same issue returned'])->assertOk();
        foreach ([$this->concern->fresh(), $this->report->fresh()] as $ticket) {
            $ticket->update(['status' => 'Resolved', 'resolved_at' => now()]);
        }
    }

    public function test_recording_replacement_clears_old_recurrence_but_preserves_ticket_history(): void
    {
        $this->reopenAndComplete();
        Report::create($this->report->only(['user_id', 'category_id', 'title', 'location', 'status', 'resolved_at', 'cost']));
        $this->assertCount(1, $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']);
        $this->recordReplacement()->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('success', true);
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']);
        $this->assertSame(2, ActivityLog::whereIn('action', ['concern_reopened', 'report_reopened'])->count());
        $this->assertEquals(150, $this->report->fresh()->cost);
        $html = app(\App\Services\TicketHistoryService::class)->renderFor($this->report->fresh(), $this->mis);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Previous repair', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('New network device, asset tag NEW-304', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Asset replaced', $html);
    }

    public function test_new_asset_first_failure_does_not_inherit_old_repair_cycles(): void
    {
        $this->reopenAndComplete();
        $this->recordReplacement()->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'New unit failed'])->assertOk();
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']);
        foreach ([$this->concern->fresh(), $this->report->fresh()] as $ticket) {
            $ticket->update(['status' => 'Resolved', 'resolved_at' => now()]);
        }
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']);
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'New unit failed again'])->assertOk();
        $issue = $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']->first();
        $this->assertSame(1, $issue['repair_cycles']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $issue['reopenings']);
        $this->assertSame(2, $issue['count']);
    }

    public function test_new_tickets_in_the_same_location_start_with_the_new_asset_history_only(): void
    {
        $this->reopenAndComplete();
        $this->recordReplacement()->assertOk();
        $new = Report::create($this->report->only(['user_id', 'category_id', 'title', 'location', 'status', 'resolved_at', 'cost']));
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']);
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('reports.reopen', $new), ['reason' => 'New asset issue returned'])->assertOk();
        $issue = $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']->first();
        $this->assertSame(1, $issue['repair_cycles']);
        $this->assertSame(2, $issue['count']);
    }

    public function test_replacement_does_not_clear_other_locations_or_other_issues(): void
    {
        $this->reopenAndComplete();
        foreach (['Room 888', 'Room 999'] as $location) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < 2; $i++) Report::create(array_merge($this->report->only(['user_id', 'category_id', 'title', 'status', 'resolved_at', 'cost']), ['location' => $location]));
        }
        for ($i = 0; $i < 2; $i++) Report::create(array_merge($this->report->only(['user_id', 'category_id', 'location', 'status', 'resolved_at', 'cost']), ['title' => 'Different issue']));
        $this->recordReplacement()->assertOk();
        $issues = $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats'];
        $this->assertCount(3, $issues);
        $this->assertSame(['Different issue'], $issues->where('location', $this->report->location)->pluck('issue')->all());
        $this->assertSame(['Room 888', 'Room 999'], $issues->where('issue', $this->report->title)->pluck('location')->sort()->values()->all());
    }

    public function test_replacement_is_staff_only_requires_resolution_and_is_idempotent(): void
    {
        $this->recordReplacement($this->reporter)->assertForbidden();
        $other = $this->user('building_admin');
        $this->recordReplacement($other)->assertForbidden();
        $this->report->update(['status' => 'Assigned']);
        $this->recordReplacement()->assertForbidden();
        $this->report->update(['status' => 'Resolved']);
        $operation = (string) \Illuminate\Support\Str::uuid();
        $first = $this->recordReplacement(null, $operation)->assertOk()->json('replacement_id');
        $this->assertSame($first, $this->recordReplacement(null, $operation)->assertOk()->json('replacement_id'));
        $this->assertSame(1, ActivityLog::where('action', 'asset_replaced')->count());
    }

    public function test_first_reopening_triggers_a_recurring_repair_decision_alert(): void
    {
        $this->assertCount(0, $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']);
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'Same issue returned'])->assertOk();
        $data = $this->recurrenceAnalytics();
        $issue = $data['recurringIssueStats']->first();
        $this->assertSame(1, $issue['reopenings']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $issue['repair_cycles']);
        $this->assertSame(2, $issue['count']);
        $this->assertEquals(150, $issue['cost']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $data['totalReports']);
        $alert = $data['decisionAlerts']->first(fn ($alert) => str_starts_with($alert['key'], 'recurring-repair-'));
        $this->assertSame('warning', $alert['level']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $alert['stats']['Reopenings']);
    }

    public function test_repeated_repair_cycles_count_history_without_double_counting_paired_logs(): void
    {
        for ($cycle = 0; $cycle < 3; $cycle++) {
            if ($cycle > 0) {
                foreach ([$this->concern->fresh(), $this->report->fresh()] as $ticket) {
                    $ticket->update(['status' => 'Resolved', 'resolved_at' => now()]);
                }
            }
            $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'Same issue returned'])->assertOk();
        }
        $this->assertSame(6, ActivityLog::whereIn('action', ['concern_reopened', 'report_reopened'])->count());
        $data = $this->recurrenceAnalytics();
        $issue = $data['recurringIssueStats']->first();
        $this->assertSame(3, $issue['reopenings']);
        $this->assertSame(3, $issue['repair_cycles']);
        $this->assertSame(4, $issue['count']);
        $this->assertSame(3, array_sum(array_column($issue['trend'], 'reports')) - 1);
        $this->assertSame('critical', $data['decisionAlerts']->first()['level']);
        ActivityLog::where('action', 'report_reopened')->orderBy('id')->first()->delete();
        $this->assertSame(3, $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']->first()['reopenings']);
    }

    public function test_latest_completed_repair_is_added_to_the_saved_repair_cycles(): void

            $ticket->update(['status' => 'Resolved', 'resolved_at' => now()]);
        }
        $issue = $this->recurrenceAnalytics()['recurringIssueStats']->first();
        $this->assertSame(2, $issue['repair_cycles']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $issue['reopenings']);
    }

    public function test_paired_legacy_snapshots_with_a_missing_resolution_date_count_once(): void

    public function test_archives_are_cleared_so_ticket_returns_to_work_queues(): void

            $ticket->archivedByUsers()->attach($this->mis->id);
        }
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'Still broken'])->assertOk();
        foreach ([$this->concern->fresh(), $this->report->fresh()] as $ticket) {
            $this->assertFalse($ticket->is_archived);
            $this->assertFalse($ticket->mis_archived);
            $this->assertNull($ticket->auto_delete_at);

        }
    }

                $response = $this->actingAs($viewer)->getJson($url)->assertOk();
                $ticket = $response->json('report') ?? $response->json('concern');
                $this->assertStringContainsString('>History</h5>', $ticket['history_html']);
                $this->assertStringContainsString('Replaced cable', $ticket['history_html']);
                $this->assertStringContainsString('Cable failed again', $ticket['history_html']);

                $this->assertSame(1, substr_count($ticket['history_html'], 'Previous repair'));
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_history_escapes_user_content_and_excludes_other_tickets(): void
    {
        $this->concern->update(['resolution_notes' => '<script>alert("notes")</script>']);
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'Still broken'])->assertOk();
        ActivityLog::where('action', 'concern_reopened')->update(['metadata' => json_encode(['reason' => '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>'])]);
        ActivityLog::create(['action' => 'concern_reopened', 'concern_id' => 9999, 'description' => 'Another private ticket', 'old_values' => ['resolution_notes' => 'Unrelated repair']]);
        $html = app(\App\Services\TicketHistoryService::class)->renderFor($this->concern->fresh(), $this->mis);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<script>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('&lt;script&gt;', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<img src=x', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Unrelated repair', $html);
    }

    public function test_repeated_repairs_remain_in_history_instead_of_being_overwritten(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'First recurrence'])->assertOk();
        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) {
            $ticket->refresh()->update(['status' => 'Resolved', 'resolved_at' => now(), 'resolution_notes' => 'Replaced switch', 'cost' => 200]);
        }
        $this->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'Second recurrence'])->assertOk();
        $html = app(\App\Services\TicketHistoryService::class)->renderFor($this->report->fresh(), $this->mis);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Replaced cable', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Replaced switch', $html);
        $this->assertSame(2, substr_count($html, 'Previous repair'));
        $this->assertLessThan(strpos($html, 'First recurrence'), strpos($html, 'Second recurrence'));
    }

    public function test_history_preserves_the_full_ticket_details_when_later_edits_change_them(): void
    {
        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) {
            $ticket->update([
                'description' => 'Original cable problem', 'details' => 'Desk 12 has no internet',
                'priority' => 'high', 'report_count' => 3,
                'budget_amount' => 150, 'budget_status' => 'approved',
                'budget_requested_by' => $this->mis->id, 'budget_reviewed_by' => $this->mis->id,
                'budget_requested_at' => now()->subDays(2), 'budget_reviewed_at' => now()->subDay(),
                'damaged_part' => 'Old network cable', 'replaced_part' => 'CAT6 cable',
            ]);
        }
        $this->concern->update(['image_path' => 'concerns/original-photo.jpg']);
        $this->actingAs($this->reporter)->postJson(route('concerns.reopen', $this->concern), ['reason' => 'Connection failed again'])->assertOk();
        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) {
            $ticket->refresh()->update(['title' => 'Updated title', 'description' => 'New description', 'details' => 'New details', 'location' => 'Room 999', 'priority' => 'low']);
        }
        $this->mis->update(['name' => 'Renamed MIS account']);
        foreach ([$this->concern, $this->report] as $ticket) {
            $html = app(\App\Services\TicketHistoryService::class)->renderFor($ticket->fresh(), $this->mis);
            foreach (['Internet unavailable', 'Original cable problem', 'Desk 12 has no internet', 'Room 301',
                'Technology/Internet', 'CAT6 cable', 'Old network cable', 'High', 'Approved', 'PHP 150.00',
                'Date submitted:', 'Work started:', 'Report count:', 'student', 'original-photo.jpg'] as $text) {
                $this->assertStringContainsString($text, $html);
            }
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Updated title', $html);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('New description', $html);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Room 999', $html);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Renamed MIS account', $html);
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Original ticket details were not recorded', $html);
        }
    }

    public function test_history_uses_the_report_assignment_and_supports_legacy_staff_assignments(): void
    {
        $this->concern->update(['assigned_to' => null]);
        $html = app(\App\Services\TicketHistoryService::class)->renderFor($this->report->fresh(), $this->mis);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Assigned to:</strong> mis', $html);
        \App\Models\MaintenanceStaff::create(['name' => 'Legacy technician', 'email' => 'tech@example.com']);
        $staff = \App\Models\MaintenanceStaff::first();
        $this->report->update(['assigned_to' => $staff->id + 100]);
        $staff->id += 100;
        $staff->save();
        $html = app(\App\Services\TicketHistoryService::class)->renderFor($this->report->fresh(), $this->mis);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Legacy technician', $html);
    }

/* FILE: tests/Feature/ReportProgressRoutingTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Middleware\RolePrefixMiddleware;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ReportProgressRoutingTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_progress_json_requests_keep_the_registered_endpoint_for_each_role(): void
    {
        foreach (['admin', 'building_admin', 'school_admin', 'mis'] as $role) {
            $this->actingAs(new User(['id' => 1, 'role' => $role]));
            $request = Request::create('/admin/reports/12/modal-data');
            $request->headers->set('Accept', 'application/json');
            $response = (new RolePrefixMiddleware)->handle($request, fn () => response()->json(['report' => ['id' => 12]]));
            $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
            $this->assertSame(12, $response->getData(true)['report']['id']);
        }
    }

    public function test_assignment_posts_are_not_redirected_but_html_pages_still_are(): void
    {
        $this->actingAs(new User(['id' => 1, 'role' => 'admin']));
        $middleware = new RolePrefixMiddleware;
        $response = $middleware->handle(Request::create('/admin/report/12/assign', 'POST'), fn () => response('assigned'));
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $response = $middleware->handle(Request::create('/admin/reports'), fn () => response('unexpected'));
        $this->assertTrue($response->isRedirect(url('/system-admin/reports')));
    }
}


/* FILE: tests/Feature/ReturningStudentImportTest.php */

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Http\Controllers\AdminController;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\UserArchiveFolder;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ReturningStudentImportTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Schema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->uuid('uuid');
            $table->string('name');
            $table->string('email');
            $table->string('password');
            $table->string('role');
            $table->json('permissions')->nullable();
            $table->boolean('is_superadmin')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_deleted')->default(false);
            $table->boolean('is_archived')->default(false);
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('archive_folder_id')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('user_archive_folders', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->string('name')->unique();
            $table->text('description')->nullable();
            $table->integer('user_count')->default(0);
            $table->boolean('is_system')->default(false);
            $table->timestamps();
        });
        Schema::create('activity_logs', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->id();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('user_id')->nullable();
            $table->unsignedBigInteger('concern_id')->nullable();
            $table->string('action');
            $table->text('description');
            $table->string('ip_address')->nullable();
            $table->text('user_agent')->nullable();
            $table->json('old_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('new_values')->nullable();
            $table->json('metadata')->nullable();
            $table->timestamps();
        });
    }

    public function test_unsafe_user_import_is_rejected_before_accounts_are_changed(): void
    {
        $actor = User::forceCreate(['name' => 'Administrator', 'email' => 'admin@example.com', 'password' => 'unchanged', 'role' => 'superadmin', 'is_superadmin' => true]);
        $this->actingAs($actor);
        $request = Request::create('/admin/users/import', 'POST', [
            'default_role' => 'student', 'file_format' => 'standard',
        ], [], ['file' => \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('users.php', '<?php echo 1;')]);
        try {
            app(AdminController::class)->importUsers($request);
            $this->fail('Executable import was accepted.');
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('file', $exception->errors());
            $this->assertSame('userImport', $exception->errorBag);
        }
        $this->assertSame(1, User::count());
        $this->assertSame(0, UserArchiveFolder::count());
    }

    public function test_random_text_import_shows_an_import_error_without_creating_records(): void
    {
        Schema::table('users', fn (Blueprint $table) => $table->string('student_id')->nullable());
        $actor = User::forceCreate(['name' => 'Administrator', 'email' => 'admin@example.com', 'password' => 'unchanged', 'role' => 'superadmin', 'is_superadmin' => true]);
        $this->actingAs($actor);
        $request = Request::create('/admin/users/import', 'POST', [
            'default_role' => 'student', 'file_format' => 'masterlist',
        ], [], ['file' => \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent('random.txt', "Random text\nThis is not a user masterlist\nMore random words\n")]);
        try {
            app(AdminController::class)->importUsers($request);
            $this->fail('Random text was reported as a successful import.');
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $exception) {
            $this->assertSame('userImport', $exception->errorBag);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('No importable users were found', $exception->errors()['file'][0]);
        }
        $this->assertSame(1, User::count());
        $this->assertSame(0, UserArchiveFolder::count());
        $this->assertSame(0, \App\Models\ActivityLog::count());
    }

    public function test_unsupported_uploads_all_use_the_import_error_feedback(): void
    {
        $actor = User::forceCreate(['name' => 'Administrator', 'email' => 'admin@example.com', 'password' => 'unchanged', 'role' => 'superadmin', 'is_superadmin' => true]);
        $this->actingAs($actor);
        $files = array_map(fn ($name) => \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->createWithContent($name, 'Not a user import'),
            ['photo.png', 'document.pdf', 'archive.zip', 'program.exe', 'invalid.xlsx']);
        $files[] = \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile::fake()->create('oversized.csv', 2049, 'text/csv');
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $request = Request::create('/admin/users/import', 'POST', [
                'default_role' => 'student', 'file_format' => 'masterlist',
            ], [], ['file' => $file]);
            try {
                app(AdminController::class)->importUsers($request);
                $this->fail('Unsupported upload was accepted: '.$file->getClientOriginalName());
            } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $exception) {
                $this->assertSame('userImport', $exception->errorBag);
                $this->assertArrayHasKey('file', $exception->errors());
            }
        }
        $this->assertSame(1, User::count());
        $this->assertSame(0, \App\Models\ActivityLog::count());
    }

    public function test_import_feedback_uses_sweetalert_and_escapes_error_text(): void

        $html = view('admin.partials.user-import-feedback', compact('errors'))->render();

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Unable to import users', $html);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('</script>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('selectImportRole(role)', $html);
    }

    public function test_email_match_restores_legacy_student_without_student_id(): void
    {
        Schema::table('users', fn (Blueprint $table) => $table->string('student_id')->nullable());
        $actor = User::forceCreate(['name' => 'Administrator', 'email' => 'admin@example.com', 'password' => 'unchanged', 'role' => 'superadmin', 'is_superadmin' => true]);
        $this->actingAs($actor);
        $folder = UserArchiveFolder::create(['name' => 'Old Year', 'user_count' => 2]);
        $returning = User::forceCreate([
            'name' => 'Returning', 'email' => 'returning@example.com', 'password' => 'unchanged',
            'role' => 'student', 'is_archived' => true, 'archive_folder_id' => $folder->id,
        ]);
        $absent = User::forceCreate([
            'name' => 'Absent', 'email' => 'absent@example.com', 'password' => 'unchanged',

        ]);
        $request = Request::create('/admin/users/import', 'POST', [

    public function test_masterlist_updates_active_student_profile_without_changing_credentials(): void
    {
        Schema::table('users', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->string('student_id')->nullable();
            $table->string('department')->nullable();
            $table->string('level')->nullable();
        });
        $actor = User::forceCreate(['name' => 'Administrator', 'email' => 'admin@example.com', 'password' => 'unchanged', 'role' => 'superadmin', 'is_superadmin' => true]);
        $this->actingAs($actor);
        $student = User::forceCreate([
            'name' => 'BSTM 1Y1 LAST,FIRST', 'email' => 'original@example.com',
            'password' => 'original-hash', 'role' => 'student', 'student_id' => '02000123456',
            'department' => 'NS', 'level' => '1Y1',
        ]);
        $request = Request::create('/admin/users/import', 'POST', [
            'default_role' => 'student', 'file_format' => 'masterlist', 'archive_folder_name' => 'New Year',
